english: Download %1$@ (one-time, ~%2$lld MB)

key: Downloads come from huggingface.co (and github.com for the voice pack), once, and then run on this Mac. Nothing is removed without asking.
value: Las descargas vienen de huggingface.co (y de github.com para el paquete de voz), una sola vez, y después se ejecutan en este Mac. No se elimina nada sin preguntarte.
english: Downloads come from huggingface.co (and github.com for the voice pack), once, and then run on this Mac. Nothing is removed without asking.

key: Dress M1K3 up for the occasional holiday — Halloween, and flight colours while you are offline.
value: Disfraza a M1K3 en fechas señaladas: Halloween, y colores de aviador cuando estás sin conexión.
note: 'flight colours' is the Offline AI Flight Club look (SeasonalLook, shown while offline); 'colores de vuelo' read as nothing in particular, 'colores de aviador' points at the pilot theme. The comma before 'y' is kept on purpose so 'cuando estás sin conexión' attaches only to the flight look.
english: Dress M1K3 up for the occasional holiday — Halloween, and flight colours while you are offline.

key: Drop a PDF or text file on the window, or activate to pick one. Files are read on this Mac only.
value: Suelta un PDF o archivo de texto en la ventana, o actívalo para elegir uno. Los archivos se leen solo en este Mac.
note: VoiceOver label for the greeting card (combined element with the button trait); 'actívalo' refers to the card.
english: Drop a PDF or text file on the window, or activate to pick one. Files are read on this Mac only.

key: Drop or import a PDF or text file and it'll appear here. Photos you ask me to remember appear too; their descriptions stay on this device.
value: Suelta o importa un PDF o archivo de texto y aparecerá aquí. Las fotos que me pidas que recuerde también aparecen; sus descripciones se quedan en este dispositivo.
note: Changed 'que me pidas recordar' to 'que me pidas que recuerde': the infinitive could be read as 'you remember'; this makes M1K3 the one who remembers.
english: Drop or import a PDF or text file and it'll appear here. Photos you ask me to remember appear too; their descriptions stay on this device.

key: Email this one exchange to Round Tower — you see the exact text first
value: Enviar solo este intercambio por correo a Round Tower: antes verás el texto exacto
note: Batch had review:false, but the line says what leaves the device (one exchange, emailed to Round Tower), so it is flagged for review.
english: Email this one exchange to Round Tower — you see the exact text first

key: Every agent you’ve connected stops reaching M1K3 until you connect it again with the new token.
value: Todos los agentes que hayas conectado dejarán de acceder a M1K3 hasta que vuelvas a conectarlos con el token nuevo.
english: Every agent you’ve connected stops reaching M1K3 until you connect it again with the new token.

key: Every app you’ve pointed at M1K3 stops working until you give it the new key.
value: Todas las apps que hayas configurado para usar M1K3 dejarán de funcionar hasta que les des la clave nueva.
english: Every app you’ve pointed at M1K3 stops working until you give it the new key.

key: Every couple of hours M1K3 can take stock — what it learned, who called in, how the machine is doing — and write a short note. Turn it on in Settings → M1K3. Kept on this machine only.
value: Cada par de horas, M1K3 puede hacer balance —lo que ha aprendido, quién ha llamado, cómo va el Mac— y escribir una nota breve. Actívalo en Ajustes → M1K3. Se guarda solo en este Mac.
note: 'this machine' rendered as 'este Mac' (glossary: never ordenador/computadora); Spanish em dashes sit flush against the aside. 'who called in' is ambiguous in the source (phone calls vs connected agents); 'quién ha llamado' keeps the same ambiguity.
english: Every couple of hours M1K3 can take stock — what it learned, who called in, how the machine is doing — and write a short note. Turn it on in Settings → M1K3. Kept on this machine only.

key: Every couple of hours M1K3 takes stock and writes a short note. Kept on this machine, capped at a week, never remembered as facts.
value: Cada par de horas, M1K3 hace balance y escribe una nota breve. Se guarda en este Mac, como máximo una semana, y nunca se recuerda como dato.
note: 'never remembered as facts' kept at full force; singular 'como dato' agrees with the one note (the plural 'como datos' read awkwardly).
english: Every couple of hours M1K3 takes stock and writes a short note. Kept on this machine, capped at a week, never remembered as facts.

key: Exports every remembered fact as plain-text Markdown. Outside M1K3 this folder is not encrypted — it's yours to guard.
value: Exporta todos los datos recordados como Markdown en texto sin formato. Fuera de M1K3, esta carpeta no está cifrada: te toca protegerla.
english: Exports every remembered fact as plain-text Markdown. Outside M1K3 this folder is not encrypted — it's yours to guard.

key: Forget this — removes it everywhere, no residue
value: Olvidar: lo borra de todas partes, sin rastro
english: Forget this — removes it everywhere, no residue

key: Full transcript in the Agent Log
value: Transcripción completa en el Registro de agentes
english: Full transcript in the Agent Log

key: How Apple protects it
value: Cómo lo protege Apple
note: Link under the Private Cloud consent text (sheet and Privacy pane); 'lo' = what is sent to Private Cloud Compute. Batch flag was false; set true because it sits in egress consent copy.
english: How Apple protects it

key: How you asked M1K3 to answer. The newest asks shape every answer on this Mac, as many as fit.
value: Cómo le pediste a M1K3 que respondiera. Las peticiones más recientes dan forma a todas las respuestas en este Mac, tantas como quepan.
english: How you asked M1K3 to answer. The newest asks shape every answer on this Mac, as many as fit.

key: I hit a snag last time. Send Round Tower a short report? You'll see it first.
value: La última vez tuve un problema. ¿Enviar un informe breve a Round Tower? Primero lo verás tú.
english: I hit a snag last time. Send Round Tower a short report? You'll see it first.

key: I remember things — properly, on this Mac.
value: Recuerdo las cosas —de verdad— en este Mac.
note: Spanish incise typography: em dashes attached to the aside (—de verdad—) rather than the English spaced dash. 'en este Mac' keeps the on-device promise exactly.
english: I remember things — properly, on this Mac.

key: Include on-device crash/hang summaries
value: Incluir resúmenes de cierres inesperados y bloqueos del dispositivo
note: Longer than the English toggle label; it sits in a Form row, so it wraps.
english: Include on-device crash/hang summaries

key: Keep it on this Mac
value: Dejarlo en este Mac
note: Cancel button on the Private Cloud consent and field-report sheets: nothing is sent.
english: Keep it on this Mac

key: Let agents delete memories
value: Permitir que los agentes eliminen recuerdos
note: Toggle; 'eliminar' per the Delete term (destroys data).
english: Let agents delete memories

key: Let agents open links on screen
value: Permitir que los agentes abran enlaces en pantalla
note: Review set to true: it is a permission toggle that sits beside items 2 and 4, which are both review:true.
english: Let agents open links on screen

key: Let agents use the microphone
value: Permitir que los agentes usen el micrófono
english: Let agents use the microphone

key: Lets M1K3 ground answers in the moment — battery, your next events, where you are (a coarse ~10 km area unless Precise is on). Snapshots only: never remembered, never mixed with web tools in a turn. macOS asks its own permission when you switch Calendar or Location on.
value: Permite que M1K3 fundamente sus respuestas en el momento: la batería, tus próximos eventos, dónde estás (una zona aproximada de unos 10 km, salvo que esté activada Ubicación exacta). Solo instantáneas: nunca se recuerdan y nunca se mezclan con las herramientas web en un mismo turno. macOS pide su propio permiso cuando activas Calendario o Ubicación.
note: Changed 'salvo que actives' to 'salvo que esté activada' so it states a setting, as 'unless Precise is on' does, not an action. 'Precise' is named in full as the 'Ubicación exacta' toggle. 'Calendario' and 'Ubicación' must match the translated toggle labels ('Calendar (titles & times)' and 'Location').
english: Lets M1K3 ground answers in the moment — battery, your next events, where you are (a coarse ~10 km area unless Precise is on). Snapshots only: never remembered, never mixed with web tools in a turn. macOS asks its own permission when you switch Calendar or Location on.

key: Lets an agent on this Mac use M1K3's knowledge, memory and voice. Loopback-only, one client at a time. An agent needs the access token to connect. Listening, deleting memories and opening links stay off until you allow them.
value: Permite que un agente de este Mac use el conocimiento, la memoria y la voz de M1K3. Solo loopback, un cliente cada vez. Un agente necesita el token de acceso para conectarse. Escuchar, eliminar recuerdos y abrir enlaces siguen desactivados hasta que los permitas.
note: 'Loopback' is kept as the technical term; a native reader may prefer 'Solo en local (loopback)'. 'cada vez' is used instead of 'a la vez', which is ambiguous in Spain (it can mean 'simultaneously').
english: Lets an agent on this Mac use M1K3's knowledge, memory and voice. Loopback-only, one client at a time. An agent needs the access token to connect. Listening, deleting memories and opening links stay off until you allow them.

key: Lets other apps on this Mac use the brain M1K3 has loaded, with their own instructions: no M1K3 personality, memory, knowledge or tools, and nothing they send is kept. Point any OpenAI-compatible tool at the base URL and use the API key. Loopback-only, one call at a time, and you always go first. M1K3's brains are chosen and tested inside M1K3; how one behaves under another app's instructions is for you to judge.
value: Permite que otras apps de este Mac usen el cerebro que M1K3 tiene cargado, con sus propias instrucciones: sin la personalidad, la memoria, el conocimiento ni las herramientas de M1K3, y no se guarda nada de lo que envían. Apunta cualquier herramienta compatible con OpenAI a la URL base y usa la clave de API. Solo loopback, una llamada cada vez, y tú siempre tienes prioridad. Los cerebros de M1K3 se eligen y se prueban dentro de M1K3; cómo se comporta uno con las instrucciones de otra app lo juzgas tú.
note: 'you always go first' was 'tú siempre vas primero', a calque that reads as taking turns. It is now 'tú siempre tienes prioridad' (your own turns are served first).
english: Lets other apps on this Mac use the brain M1K3 has loaded, with their own instructions: no M1K3 personality, memory, knowledge or tools, and nothing they send is kept. Point any OpenAI-compatible tool at the base URL and use the API key. Loopback-only, one call at a time, and you always go first. M1K3's brains are chosen and tested inside M1K3; how one behaves under another app's instructions is for you to judge.

key: Local API
value: Local API
english: Local API

key: Local API (OpenAI-compatible, localhost)
value: Local API (compatible con OpenAI, localhost)
english: Local API (OpenAI-compatible, localhost)

key: Logging is on. As a connected agent calls M1K3's tools, the requests and responses will appear here.
value: El registro está activado. Cuando un agente conectado llame a las herramientas de M1K3, las solicitudes y las respuestas aparecerán aquí.
english: Logging is on. As a connected agent calls M1K3's tools, the requests and responses will appear here.

key: Looking at what's already on this Mac…
value: Comprobando lo que ya hay en este Mac…
note: Shown while the kit card checks which downloads already exist; 'Comprobando' reads better than a literal 'Mirando'.
english: Looking at what's already on this Mac…

key: M1K3 doesn't capture agent conversations by default. Turn on “Log agent conversations” in Settings → Server to review what a connected agent asks for and hears back — on this Mac only.
value: M1K3 no registra las conversaciones de los agentes de forma predeterminada. Activa “Registrar conversaciones de agentes” en Ajustes → Servidor para revisar lo que pide y lo que recibe un agente conectado, solo en este Mac.
note: The quoted toggle name must match item 18. 'capture' is rendered as 'registra' to match the Log toggle wording.
english: M1K3 doesn't capture agent conversations by default. Turn on “Log agent conversations” in Settings → Server to review what a connected agent asks for and hears back — on this Mac only.

key: M1K3 extracts durable facts about you — preferences, decisions, people — from conversations, on-device. Review and erase anytime.
value: M1K3 extrae datos duraderos sobre ti (preferencias, decisiones, personas) de las conversaciones, en el dispositivo. Revísalos y bórralos cuando quieras.
english: M1K3 extracts durable facts about you — preferences, decisions, people — from conversations, on-device. Review and erase anytime.

key: M1K3 is built with open-source components. Everything runs on this Mac.
value: M1K3 está hecho con componentes de código abierto. Todo se ejecuta en este Mac.
note: 'código abierto' describes the third-party components only, not M1K3 itself, so the brand rule holds.
english: M1K3 is built with open-source components. Everything runs on this Mac.

key: M1K3 keeps your words on this Mac — ask it anything.
value: M1K3 guarda tus palabras en este Mac: pregúntale lo que quieras.
note: Sample sentence for the Reading-mode live preview. It is also a privacy claim, so it is marked for review.
english: M1K3 keeps your words on this Mac — ask it anything.

key: M1K3 won't open a page on this Mac or a private network.
value: M1K3 no abrirá una página de este Mac ni de una red privada.
english: M1K3 won't open a page on this Mac or a private network.

key: M1K3's "hands" — it can only propose a script; every install and approval is your click, and only the exact approved bytes ever run. Script output can't reach the web tools in the same turn and never becomes a remembered fact. An approved script can be re-run later with different input, so approve only scripts you trust with anything.
value: Las “manos” de M1K3: solo puede proponer un script; cada instalación y cada aprobación es un clic tuyo, y solo se ejecutan exactamente los bytes aprobados. La salida de un script no puede llegar a las herramientas web en el mismo turno y nunca se convierte en un dato recordado. Un script aprobado puede volver a ejecutarse más tarde con otra entrada, así que aprueba solo los scripts a los que confiarías cualquier cosa.
note: The batch says review:false, but this line states what a script can reach and what is never remembered, so review is set to true.
english: M1K3's "hands" — it can only propose a script; every install and approval is your click, and only the exact approved bytes ever run. Script output can't reach the web tools in the same turn and never becomes a remembered fact. An approved script can be re-run later with different input, so approve only scripts you trust with anything.

key: MCP server (HTTP, localhost)
value: Servidor MCP (HTTP, localhost)
english: MCP server (HTTP, localhost)

key: Make a new API key?
value: ¿Crear una clave de API nueva?
english: Make a new API key?

key: Needs Private Cloud Compute on in Settings ▸ Privacy.
value: Requiere activar Private Cloud Compute en Ajustes ▸ Privacidad.
english: Needs Private Cloud Compute on in Settings ▸ Privacy.

key: No third-party licenses found.
value: No se han encontrado licencias de terceros.
english: No third-party licenses found.

key: Notch HUD, heartbeat, senses, Private Cloud Compute (asks per message) — all on.
value: HUD de la muesca, latido, sentidos, Private Cloud Compute (pregunta en cada mensaje): todo activado.
english: Notch HUD, heartbeat, senses, Private Cloud Compute (asks per message) — all on.

key: Nothing runs until you install it. Installed scripts live in M1K3's scripts folder, and only the exact bytes you approve can ever run — if the file changes, M1K3 refuses until you re-approve.
value: Nada se ejecuta hasta que lo instales. Los scripts instalados se guardan en la carpeta de scripts de M1K3, y en ningún caso puede ejecutarse nada más que los bytes exactos que apruebes: si el archivo cambia, M1K3 se niega a ejecutarlo hasta que vuelvas a aprobarlo.
note: Reviewer change: the draft 'solo pueden ejecutarse' dropped 'ever'. 'en ningún caso puede ejecutarse nada más que' says the same thing (only X, ever) and is not stronger. Also 'se niega' became 'se niega a ejecutarlo' because Spanish needs the object. A native reader should check the privacy line.
english: Nothing runs until you install it. Installed scripts live in M1K3's scripts folder, and only the exact bytes you approve can ever run — if the file changes, M1K3 refuses until you re-approve.

key: Off by default. When on, M1K3 keeps the last 500 tool calls a connected agent makes — see them in Window → Agent Log, or the Heartbeat timeline.
value: Desactivado por defecto. Si lo activas, M1K3 guarda las últimas 500 llamadas a herramientas que hace un agente conectado: puedes verlas en Ventana → Registro de agentes o en la cronología del Latido.
note: Flagged: says what M1K3 keeps and 'by default'. 'Window' menu is 'Ventana' in Spanish macOS.
english: Off by default. When on, M1K3 keeps the last 500 tool calls a connected agent makes — see them in Window → Agent Log, or the Heartbeat timeline.

key: Off unless you turn it on. Then Private Cloud Compute joins the brain picker, and once you pick it, it stays picked until you choose a brain on this Mac. The first time, you see exactly what goes before it goes, and each answer is labelled.
value: Desactivado salvo que lo actives. Entonces Private Cloud Compute se suma al selector de cerebros y, una vez que lo eliges, se queda elegido hasta que elijas un cerebro en este Mac. La primera vez ves exactamente lo que se envía antes de que se envíe, y cada respuesta va etiquetada.
english: Off unless you turn it on. Then Private Cloud Compute joins the brain picker, and once you pick it, it stays picked until you choose a brain on this Mac. The first time, you see exactly what goes before it goes, and each answer is labelled.

key: One-time downloads. None of your data goes with them.
value: Descargas únicas. Ninguno de tus datos viaja con ellas.
note: Reviewer change: 'va con ellas' became 'viaja con ellas', which reads more naturally. The promise has the same force.
english: One-time downloads. None of your data goes with them.

key: Only approve a device you're holding right now.
value: Aprueba un dispositivo solo si lo tienes en la mano ahora mismo.
note: Reviewer change: 'Aprueba solo un dispositivo…' could read as 'approve just one device'. The condition is now explicit, with the same meaning as the English.
english: Only approve a device you're holding right now.

key: PDF or text — read here, never uploaded.
value: PDF o texto: se lee aquí, nunca se sube.
english: PDF or text — read here, never uploaded.

key: Paused: Private Cloud Compute is off in Settings ▸ Privacy. Turning that on resumes this.
value: En pausa: Private Cloud Compute está desactivado en Ajustes ▸ Privacidad. Al activarlo, esto se reanuda.
english: Paused: Private Cloud Compute is off in Settings ▸ Privacy. Turning that on resumes this.

key: Photo remembered. The caption stays on this device.
value: Foto recordada. El pie de foto se queda en este dispositivo.
english: Photo remembered. The caption stays on this device.

key: Pings you when a long reply finishes or a brain loads — only while M1K3's in the background, never with the reply itself.
value: Te avisa cuando termina una respuesta larga o se carga un cerebro, solo mientras M1K3 está en segundo plano, y el aviso nunca incluye la respuesta en sí.
note: Reviewer: 'nunca con la respuesta en sí' was ambiguous (could read as 'never at the same time as the reply'); the English means the notification never carries the reply text, so the subject is made explicit. 'only' and 'never' kept at the same force. Privacy line (what a notification shows), review true.
english: Pings you when a long reply finishes or a brain loads — only while M1K3's in the background, never with the reply itself.

key: Private Cloud Compute
value: Private Cloud Compute
english: Private Cloud Compute

key: Private · download & go →
value: Privado · descargar y empezar →
english: Private · download & go →

key: Private →
value: Privado →
english: Private →

key: Puts your document and call titles — never contents or memories — into Spotlight (⌘Space). Managed by macOS; turning off removes everything M1K3 donated.
value: Añade a Spotlight (⌘Espacio) los títulos de tus documentos y llamadas —nunca su contenido ni los recuerdos—. Lo gestiona macOS; al desactivarlo se elimina todo lo que M1K3 haya aportado.
note: Reviewer: 'Pone en Spotlight' read as a calque of 'puts into'; 'Añade a Spotlight' is the natural verb. 'never' kept literally. Privacy line (what leaves the app for Spotlight), review true. 'Space' shown as 'Espacio' as Spanish keyboards label it.
english: Puts your document and call titles — never contents or memories — into Spotlight (⌘Space). Managed by macOS; turning off removes everything M1K3 donated.

key: Recall a specific memory from M1K3's private memory graph.
value: Recupera un recuerdo concreto del grafo de memoria privado de M1K3.
english: Recall a specific memory from M1K3's private memory graph.

key: Record a call from the chat toolbar (consent-gated). With transcription enabled, a stopped recording is transcribed, summarised, encrypted, and indexed — on-device.
value: Graba una llamada desde la barra de herramientas del chat (requiere consentimiento). Con la transcripción activada, al detener una grabación se transcribe, se resume, se cifra y se indexa, todo en el dispositivo.
note: Reviewer: the trailing ', en el dispositivo' read as attached to 'se indexa' only; the English dash scopes 'on-device' over all four steps, so 'todo en el dispositivo' restores that scope without strengthening the promise. Privacy line (consent, on-device processing).
english: Record a call from the chat toolbar (consent-gated). With transcription enabled, a stopped recording is transcribed, summarised, encrypted, and indexed — on-device.

key: Remembered on this device
value: Recordada en este dispositivo
note: Label under the remembered photo (RememberPhotoButton.swift:60). The participle is feminine to agree with 'foto' ('Foto recordada'). It says where the caption stays, so review is true.
english: Remembered on this device

key: Runs on Mini, Apple's on-device model · change anytime in Settings.
value: Funciona con Mini, el modelo de Apple en el dispositivo · cámbialo cuando quieras en Ajustes.
note: Says where the model runs. 'on-device' is kept literally as 'en el dispositivo', per the glossary.
english: Runs on Mini, Apple's on-device model · change anytime in Settings.

key: Save a fact to M1K3’s private memory.
value: Guarda un dato en la memoria privada de M1K3.
english: Save a fact to M1K3’s private memory.

key: Scan this in M1K3 on the other device. The code lives for a minute and commits nothing until you approve.
value: Escanea esto con M1K3 en el otro dispositivo. El código dura un minuto y no se aplica nada hasta que lo apruebes.
note: Pairing consent copy (Brain at Home). Changed 'no confirma nada', which a lay reader takes as 'confirms nothing', to 'no se aplica nada hasta que lo apruebes' (nothing takes effect until you approve), and 'en M1K3' to 'con M1K3' to avoid 'en M1K3 en'. The force is the same as 'commits nothing until you approve'. A native reader should confirm.
english: Scan this in M1K3 on the other device. The code lives for a minute and commits nothing until you approve.

key: Search M1K3's local knowledge base for documents, notes, and memories.
value: Busca documentos, notas y recuerdos en la base de conocimiento local de M1K3.
english: Search M1K3's local knowledge base for documents, notes, and memories.

key: Send a short report to Round Tower?
value: ¿Enviar un informe breve a Round Tower?
english: Send a short report to Round Tower?

key: Send this exchange to Round Tower?
value: ¿Enviar este intercambio a Round Tower?
note: 'intercambio' (one question and its answer) is used rather than 'conversación', which would overstate what is sent.
english: Send this exchange to Round Tower?

key: Send to Private Cloud Compute
value: Enviar a Private Cloud Compute
english: Send to Private Cloud Compute

key: Send to Private Cloud Compute?
value: ¿Enviar a Private Cloud Compute?
english: Send to Private Cloud Compute?

key: Serve my brain to my devices
value: Ofrecer mi cerebro a mis dispositivos
note: Changed from 'Usar mi cerebro desde mis dispositivos', which moved the subject to the other devices. The toggle is on the Mac and serves its brain to paired devices. 'Ofrecer' matches the description line ('Ofrece generación sin procesar…'). Flagged review:true because this toggle turns on serving to other devices (who receives the output), so it belongs with the Brain at Home privacy copy.
english: Serve my brain to my devices

key: Serves raw generation to devices you pair by QR code — local network only, encrypted with a key that never travels the network; no persona, memory, or documents included. The MCP toggle adds read-only tools (search, documents, ask) — asks can reach the web when the web-search toggle allows. Off by default; revoking a device cuts it off immediately.
value: Ofrece generación sin procesar a los dispositivos que emparejes con un código QR: solo en la red local, cifrada con una clave que nunca viaja por la red; no incluye personalidad, memoria ni documentos. El interruptor MCP añade herramientas de solo lectura (búsqueda, documentos, preguntar): las preguntas pueden llegar a la web cuando el interruptor de búsqueda web lo permite. Desactivado por defecto; revocar un dispositivo lo desconecta al instante.
note: Privacy copy, translated literally. 'solo', 'nunca' and 'Desactivado por defecto' keep the English force. 'cifrada' agrees with 'generación'.
english: Serves raw generation to devices you pair by QR code — local network only, encrypted with a key that never travels the network; no persona, memory, or documents included. The MCP toggle adds read-only tools (search, documents, ask) — asks can reach the web when the web-search toggle allows. Off by default; revoking a device cuts it off immediately.

key: Serving on :%@ to ^[%@ paired device](inflect: true)
value: Sirviendo en :%1$@ a ^[%2$@ dispositivo emparejado](inflect: true)
english: Serving on :%1$@ to ^[%2$@ paired device](inflect: true)

key: Shared from M1K3 · m1k3.app
value: Compartido desde M1K3 · m1k3.app
english: Shared from M1K3 · m1k3.app

key: Short earcons for errors, saved memories, and voice mode waking up — never over M1K3's voice. The dial-up sound plays while a brain loads and has its own switch since it loops.
value: Sonidos breves para errores, recuerdos guardados y el despertar del modo de voz; nunca por encima de la voz de M1K3. El sonido de módem suena mientras se carga un cerebro y tiene su propio interruptor, porque se repite en bucle.
english: Short earcons for errors, saved memories, and voice mode waking up — never over M1K3's voice. The dial-up sound plays while a brain loads and has its own switch since it loops.

key: Show documents & calls in Spotlight
value: Mostrar documentos y llamadas en Spotlight
english: Show documents & calls in Spotlight

key: Show exactly what that sends
value: Mostrar exactamente lo que se envía
note: Disclosure under 'Also send this conversation' in the Private Cloud consent sheet.
english: Show exactly what that sends

key: Start a fresh conversation — this one stays in Conversations (⌘N)
value: Empezar una conversación nueva: esta se queda en Conversaciones (⌘N)
english: Start a fresh conversation — this one stays in Conversations (⌘N)

key: Stops listening without sending
value: Deja de escuchar sin enviar

english: This device has no camera M1K3 can use.

key: This device’s pairing key is missing — pair with your Mac again.
value: Falta la clave de emparejamiento de este dispositivo — vuelve a emparejarlo con tu Mac.
english: This device’s pairing key is missing — pair with your Mac again.

key: This is the whole message: that %@ couldn't get ready, what M1K3 showed you, the app and system versions, and M1K3's download log from this session. Nothing you typed or said goes with it. It goes to %@ from your own mail app, which opens with it filled in. M1K3 sends nothing itself. Round Tower reads it to find what went wrong, and deletes it if you ask.
value: Este es el mensaje completo: que %1$@ no pudo prepararse, lo que M1K3 te mostró, las versiones de la app y del sistema, y el registro de descargas de M1K3 de esta sesión. Nada de lo que escribiste o dijiste va incluido. Se envía a %2$@ desde tu propia app de correo, que se abre con el mensaje ya completado. M1K3 no envía nada por sí mismo. Round Tower lo lee para averiguar qué falló y lo elimina si se lo pides.
note: Privacy line, literal. %1$@ brain name, %2$@ recipient address. 'va con él' (calque) → 'va incluido'. No code site found (possibly stale key).
english: This is the whole message: that %1$@ couldn't get ready, what M1K3 showed you, the app and system versions, and M1K3's download log from this session. Nothing you typed or said goes with it. It goes to %2$@ from your own mail app, which opens with it filled in. M1K3 sends nothing itself. Round Tower reads it to find what went wrong, and deletes it if you ask.

key: This is the whole message: that M1K3 didn't close cleanly last time, when that session began, the brain, the app and system versions, and any crash summaries this device kept. Nothing you typed or said goes with it. It goes to %@ from your own mail app, which opens with it filled in. M1K3 sends nothing itself. Round Tower reads it to find what went wrong, and deletes it if you ask. If you remember what you were doing, add it at the end: that helps most.
value: Este es el mensaje completo: que M1K3 no se cerró correctamente la última vez, cuándo empezó esa sesión, el cerebro, las versiones de la app y del sistema, y los resúmenes de cierres inesperados que haya guardado este dispositivo. Nada de lo que escribiste o dijiste va incluido. Se envía a %@ desde tu propia app de correo, que se abre con el mensaje ya completado. M1K3 no envía nada por sí mismo. Round Tower lo lee para averiguar qué falló y lo elimina si se lo pides. Si recuerdas qué estabas haciendo, añádelo al final: es lo que más ayuda.
note: Privacy line, literal. 'any crash summaries' → subjunctive 'que haya guardado' (there may be none). No code site found.
english: This is the whole message: that M1K3 didn't close cleanly last time, when that session began, the brain, the app and system versions, and any crash summaries this device kept. Nothing you typed or said goes with it. It goes to %@ from your own mail app, which opens with it filled in. M1K3 sends nothing itself. Round Tower reads it to find what went wrong, and deletes it if you ask. If you remember what you were doing, add it at the end: that helps most.

key: Turns the camera off
value: Apaga la cámara
note: VoiceOver hint; Spanish hints use the third-person form, which coincides with the tú imperative.
english: Turns the camera off

key: Turns the camera on so M1K3 answers about what you point it at
value: Enciende la cámara para que M1K3 responda sobre lo que enfoques
english: Turns the camera on so M1K3 answers about what you point it at

key: Uses Apple's Declared Age Range to adjust content for younger users. Web search is disabled for under 16; the assistant's tone adjusts for all minors. Declining gives full capability.
value: Usa el Rango de edad declarado (Declared Age Range) de Apple para adaptar el contenido a los usuarios más jóvenes. La búsqueda web está desactivada para menores de 16 años; el tono del asistente se adapta para todos los menores de edad. Si lo rechazas, tienes todas las funciones.
note: Apple's own Spanish name for Declared Age Range is unconfirmed: a native reader should check it and drop the English parenthesis if Apple's term is known. No code site found.
english: Uses Apple's Declared Age Range to adjust content for younger users. Web search is disabled for under 16; the assistant's tone adjusts for all minors. Declining gives full capability.

key: Voice mode, microphone parked
value: Modo de voz, micrófono en pausa
note: VoiceOver label for the idle state; 'parked' rendered as 'en pausa'.
english: Voice mode, microphone parked

key: Web search in chat
value: Búsqueda web en el chat
english: Web search in chat

key: Web search sends your query to DuckDuckGo. Private Cloud Compute, under Brain, sends your messages to Apple. %@
value: La búsqueda web envía tu consulta a DuckDuckGo. Private Cloud Compute, en la sección Cerebro, envía tus mensajes a Apple. %@
note: 'under Brain' names the Settings Section("Brain") (SettingsScreen.swift:137), translated 'Cerebro'; 'en la sección' makes clear it is a place. %@ is PrivateCloudTurn.appleGuarantee, appended as its own sentence: it must be localized for this line to read in one language.
english: Web search sends your query to DuckDuckGo. Private Cloud Compute, under Brain, sends your messages to Apple. %@

key: Write a short description of this photo and remember it. The description stays on this device.
value: Escribir una breve descripción de esta foto y recordarla. La descripción se queda en este dispositivo.
note: No code site found (possibly stale); infinitive since it reads as an action description. Privacy line, literal.
english: Write a short description of this photo and remember it. The description stays on this device.

key: Writes a search for you to read and send. Nothing is sent until you send it
value: Redacta una búsqueda para que tú la leas y la envíes. No se envía nada hasta que la envíes
note: VoiceOver hint, no final period as in English. 'Escribe una búsqueda para que la leas' read as an instruction to the user; 'Redacta … para que tú …' keeps M1K3 as the subject. Privacy promise kept literal.
english: Writes a search for you to read and send. Nothing is sent until you send it

key: Writes a short description and remembers it on this device
value: Escribe una breve descripción y la recuerda en este dispositivo
note: VoiceOver hint, third person (M1K3 is the subject; 'la recuerda' disambiguates). No code site found.
english: Writes a short description and remembers it on this device

key: Your Mac’s brain, over your Wi‑Fi — pair to use it
value: El cerebro de tu Mac, a través de tu Wi‑Fi — empareja para usarlo
note: Non-breaking hyphen (U+2011) in Wi‑Fi kept. review → true: Brain at Home lines say where the conversation goes (glossary privacy list).
english: Your Mac’s brain, over your Wi‑Fi — pair to use it

key: Your Mac’s brain, over your own Wi‑Fi. Scan a code to pair.
value: El cerebro de tu Mac, a través de tu propia Wi‑Fi. Escanea un código para emparejar.
note: Non-breaking hyphen kept; 'la Wi‑Fi' feminine. review → true (Brain at Home egress line).
english: Your Mac’s brain, over your own Wi‑Fi. Scan a code to pair.

key: Your mail app didn't open it. The full text is on your clipboard — paste it into an email to %@.
value: Tu app de correo no lo abrió. El texto completo está en tu portapapeles — pégalo en un correo para %@.
note: review → true to match its siblings i=43/44: it says how the report leaves the device. No code site found.
english: Your mail app didn't open it. The full text is on your clipboard — paste it into an email to %@.

key: Your mail app opened with the start of it. The message was too long for one link, so the full text is on your clipboard — paste it in before you send.
value: Tu app de correo se abrió con el principio del mensaje. Era demasiado largo para un solo enlace, así que el texto completo está en tu portapapeles — pégalo antes de enviarlo.
english: Your mail app opened with the start of it. The message was too long for one link, so the full text is on your clipboard — paste it in before you send.

key: Your mail app should now show it, addressed and filled in; it goes when you send it there. If no message appeared, Copy instead still has the text.
value: Tu app de correo debería mostrarlo ahora, con el destinatario y el texto ya completados; sale cuando lo envíes desde ahí. Si no apareció ningún mensaje, “Copiar en su lugar” sigue teniendo el texto.
note: Quotes swapped «» → “” per the glossary. 'se envía cuando lo envíes' was redundant → 'sale cuando lo envíes'. Names the 'Copy instead' button (SnagNoteHost.swift:152): the iOS 'Copy instead' key must also be 'Copiar en su lugar' (the Mac draft uses it).
english: Your mail app should now show it, addressed and filled in; it goes when you send it there. If no message appeared, Copy instead still has the text.

key: Your next message is answered by looking at this photo again, on this device
value: Tu próximo mensaje se responde volviendo a mirar esta foto, en este dispositivo
note: Accessibility hint. 'on this device' kept literal ('en este dispositivo'), no strengthening.
english: Your next message is answered by looking at this photo again, on this device

key: Your next message is answered from this text again, on this device
value: Tu próximo mensaje se responde de nuevo a partir de este texto, en este dispositivo
note: Accessibility hint. 'on this device' kept literal.
english: Your next message is answered from this text again, on this device

key: Your thumbs up and down, with any notes, and the question and answer each one rates. They stay on this device unless you export them.
value: Tus valoraciones con el pulgar arriba y abajo, con las notas que hayas añadido, y la pregunta y la respuesta que valora cada una. Se quedan en este dispositivo a menos que las exportes.
note: Changed 'que añadieras' (imperfect subjunctive, reads oddly here) to 'que hayas añadido'. Privacy clause literal: 'stay on this device unless you export them' → 'Se quedan en este dispositivo a menos que las exportes'.
english: Your thumbs up and down, with any notes, and the question and answer each one rates. They stay on this device unless you export them.

key: pair with your Mac
value: empareja con tu Mac
english: pair with your Mac

key: NSCameraUsageDescription
value: M1K3 usa la cámara solo para escanear el código de emparejamiento que muestra tu Mac para Brain at Home. No se capturan ni se guardan fotos ni vídeos.
note: Privacy prompt (camera permission), literal: 'only' → 'solo', 'No photos or video are captured or stored' kept at the same strength. 'vídeos' is the Spain spelling Apple uses in es-ES; Latin America writes 'videos'. A native reader should choose one for the single es locale and use it everywhere.
english: M1K3 uses the camera only to scan the pairing code your Mac shows for Brain at Home. No photos or video are captured or stored.

key: NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription
value: Brain at Home se conecta a tu propio Mac a través de tu red Wi-Fi para que este dispositivo pueda usar el cerebro más grande de tu Mac. Esa conexión se queda en tu propia red, cifrada.
note: Privacy prompt (local network permission), literal. Changed 'su cerebro más grande' to 'el cerebro más grande de tu Mac': the Spanish possessive 'su' could point at 'este dispositivo', but the English 'its' means the Mac. 'Wi-Fi' is Apple's UI spelling (the store copy says 'wifi' casually).
english: Brain at Home connects to your own Mac over your Wi-Fi so this device can use its bigger brain. That connection stays on your own network, encrypted.

key: NSMicrophoneUsageDescription
value: M1K3 usa el micrófono para las conversaciones de voz. El audio se transcribe en el dispositivo y nunca sale de tu dispositivo.
note: Privacy prompt (microphone permission), literal: 'never' → 'nunca'. It says 'dispositivo' twice because the English says 'device' twice. No change.
english: M1K3 uses the microphone for voice conversations. Audio is transcribed on-device and never leaves your device.

key: NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription
value: M1K3 usa el reconocimiento de voz de Apple en el dispositivo, así que tu voz se queda en este dispositivo. Nunca se envía a ningún servidor.
note: Privacy prompt (speech recognition permission), literal. Changed 'Nunca se envía a un servidor' to 'Nunca se envía a ningún servidor'. Spanish negation calls for 'ningún' here, and it keeps the same force as the English 'never sent to a server', meaning any server.
english: M1K3 uses Apple's on-device speech recognition, so your voice stays on this device. It is never sent to a server.

key: Sends it as your next message
value: Lo envía como tu siguiente mensaje
note: VoiceOver hint on a choice button: third person, as Apple's Spanish hints are; 'lo' is the chosen option. Kept review:true from the batch (it says what gets sent as the user's turn).
english: Sends it as your next message

key: Offline? I'm still right here, on your device.
value: ¿Sin conexión? Sigo aquí mismo, en tu dispositivo.
note: 50 characters, under the 70-character limit. Like the English, it promises presence and not answers, and 'on your device' stays literal.
english: Offline? I'm still right here, on your device.

key: Microphone access is off. Enable it in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone.
value: El acceso al micrófono está desactivado. Actívalo en Ajustes del Sistema → Privacidad y seguridad → Micrófono.
note: Permission line, held for native review. 'Actívalo' agrees with 'acceso' (masculine). Pane names follow Apple's Spanish macOS wording (Ajustes del Sistema → Privacidad y seguridad → Micrófono). Check them against a live Spanish macOS 27.
english: Microphone access is off. Enable it in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone.

key: The microphone isn’t ready yet — try again in a moment.
value: El micrófono aún no está listo. Inténtalo de nuevo en un momento.
note: The English dash is now a full stop, which reads more naturally in Spanish. The review flag comes from the batch (a microphone line). This is the .formatUnavailable case at StereoCallRecorder.swift:291. It is not a permission error; the earlier draft note called it one.
english: The microphone isn’t ready yet — try again in a moment.

key: %@ answers. Web search is off.
value: %@ responde. La búsqueda web está desactivada.
note: VoiceOver label; %@ is the brain name or Private Cloud Compute, kept untranslated. Web search state translated literally.
english: %@ answers. Web search is off.

key: %@ answers. Web search is on.
value: %@ responde. La búsqueda web está activada.
note: VoiceOver label; %@ is the brain name or Private Cloud Compute, kept untranslated. Web search state translated literally.
english: %@ answers. Web search is on.

key: %@ can't remember photos. Switch to Lil to remember photos.
value: %@ no puede recordar fotos. Cambia a Lil para recordar fotos.
english: %@ can't remember photos. Switch to Lil to remember photos.

key: This brain can't read photos right now.
value: Este cerebro no puede leer fotos ahora mismo.
english: This brain can't read photos right now.

key: %@ are each a switch in Settings.
value: %@ tienen cada uno un interruptor en Ajustes.
note: First-run privacy line (the Settings-switch sentence). Dropped the draft's 'propio' ('own'), which the English does not say. NetworkCrossings.swift:joined() still builds the %@ list with a hard-coded English ' and ' / ', and ', so Spanish shows 'Búsqueda web and Private Cloud Compute'. Fix the joiner (ListFormatter) before shipping. With the mixed-gender list, 'cada uno' is the correct masculine default.
english: %@ are each a switch in Settings.

key: %@ is a switch in Settings.
value: %@ tiene un interruptor en Ajustes.
note: Literal 'is a switch' → 'tiene un interruptor'. Dropped the draft's 'propio'. This wording works for 'Búsqueda web' (f.) and 'Private Cloud Compute' with no gender agreement. It is part of the first-run privacy line.
english: %@ is a switch in Settings.

key: A fully local engine — multi-turn conversation, memory, and reasoning that keeps up with you. Runs entirely on your Vision Pro.
value: Un motor totalmente local: conversación de varios turnos, memoria y un razonamiento que te sigue el ritmo. Funciona por completo en tu Vision Pro.
english: A fully local engine — multi-turn conversation, memory, and reasoning that keeps up with you. Runs entirely on your Vision Pro.

key: A fully local engine — multi-turn conversation, memory, and reasoning that keeps up with you. Runs entirely on your device.
value: Un motor totalmente local: conversación de varios turnos, memoria y un razonamiento que te sigue el ritmo. Funciona por completo en tu dispositivo.
english: A fully local engine — multi-turn conversation, memory, and reasoning that keeps up with you. Runs entirely on your device.

key: A fully local engine — multi-turn conversation, memory, and reasoning that keeps up with you. Runs entirely on your machine.
value: Un motor totalmente local: conversación de varios turnos, memoria y un razonamiento que te sigue el ritmo. Funciona por completo en tu Mac.
english: A fully local engine — multi-turn conversation, memory, and reasoning that keeps up with you. Runs entirely on your machine.

key: Apple's built-in on-device model. No download. The quickest way to start.
value: El modelo integrado de Apple, en el dispositivo. Sin descarga. La forma más rápida de empezar.
english: Apple's built-in on-device model. No download. The quickest way to start.

key: Besides model downloads, the one capability that sends anything off this Mac: every search and page read shows in the reply as it happens. Date, time, and system tools stay local either way.
value: Aparte de las descargas de modelos, es la única función que envía algo fuera de este Mac: cada búsqueda y cada página leída aparecen en la respuesta en el momento. La fecha, la hora y las herramientas del sistema siguen siendo locales en cualquier caso.
note: Privacy footer, translated literally ('the one capability' → 'la única función').
english: Besides model downloads, the one capability that sends anything off this Mac: every search and page read shows in the reply as it happens. Date, time, and system tools stay local either way.

key: Every search and page read shows in the reply as it happens. Date, time, and system tools stay local either way.
value: Cada búsqueda y cada página leída aparecen en la respuesta en el momento. La fecha, la hora y las herramientas del sistema siguen siendo locales en cualquier caso.
note: The App Store lane's web-search privacy footer. The batch had review:false, but the line says what stays local, so review is set to true.
english: Every search and page read shows in the reply as it happens. Date, time, and system tools stay local either way.

key: Maximum capability, fully local. The full M1K3.
value: Máxima capacidad, totalmente local. M1K3 al completo.
english: Maximum capability, fully local. The full M1K3.

key: My everyday brain. Quick, sees pictures, lives on this Mac.
value: Mi cerebro de todos los días. Rápido, ve imágenes y vive en este Mac.
english: My everyday brain. Quick, sees pictures, lives on this Mac.

key: Your local AI companion. Runs on this Mac — no account. It goes online only to %@. %@
value: Tu compañero de IA local. Funciona en este Mac — sin cuenta. Solo se conecta a internet para %1$@. %2$@
note: %1$@ is a list of infinitive phrases ('descargar los modelos que elijas…', 'buscar en la web…', 'actualizarse', 'usar el cerebro opcional de Private Cloud Compute'). They must be Spanish infinitives that read after 'para'. The list joiner is still the English 'and' (see item 0). 'only' is kept as 'Solo'.
english: Your local AI companion. Runs on this Mac — no account. It goes online only to %1$@. %2$@

key: download the models you choose (brains, speech, voice)
value: descargar los modelos que elijas (cerebros, reconocimiento de voz, voz)
note: Infinitive fragment that completes the lead-in 'Solo se conecta a internet para …' in the Hello privacy line. 'speech' means the speech-recognition models (WhisperKit), so 'reconocimiento de voz' is accurate, and it keeps them apart from 'voz' (spoken output, Kokoro). Flagged for review because it says what goes online.
english: download the models you choose (brains, speech, voice)

key: email one exchange, or a short report after a snag or a failed brain download, to Round Tower when you choose to
value: enviar por correo a Round Tower un intercambio, o un breve informe tras un contratiempo o una descarga fallida de un cerebro, cuando tú lo decidas
note: Infinitive fragment. Changed 'una descarga de cerebro fallida' to 'una descarga fallida de un cerebro' (the adjective was cut off from its noun, which read like a calque). 'Round Tower' stays in English. 'when you choose to' is kept literal as 'cuando tú lo decidas', so the opt-in per message is neither softened nor strengthened. 'un intercambio' (one question and its answer) is understandable but a little formal; 'una conversación' would overstate what is sent, so a native reader should confirm it. As of NetworkCrossings.swift:146 this phrase is not rendered (fieldReport is madeByApp false, so helloPrivacyLine filters it out) and no other code reads .phrase.
english: email one exchange, or a short report after a snag or a failed brain download, to Round Tower when you choose to

key: search the web and look things up
value: buscar en la web y consultar información
note: Infinitive fragment that completes 'Solo se conecta a internet para …'. It is privacy copy (web search leaves the device) and the batch already marks it for review.
english: search the web and look things up

key: use the optional Private Cloud Compute brain
value: usar el cerebro opcional de Private Cloud Compute
note: Infinitive fragment. 'Private Cloud Compute' stays as Apple's name, and 'opcional' is literal (opt-in). Privacy line: this crossing sends history to PCC.
english: use the optional Private Cloud Compute brain

key: A warm, natural neural voice that runs entirely on your Mac. One download, then offline forever. The voice M1K3 was meant to have.
value: Una voz neuronal cálida y natural que funciona por completo en tu Mac. Una sola descarga y, después, sin conexión para siempre. La voz que M1K3 siempre debió tener.
note: 'siempre debió tener' is the idiom for 'was meant to have'. Without 'siempre' it reads as past regret. 'runs entirely on your Mac' is kept exactly as strong.
english: A warm, natural neural voice that runs entirely on your Mac. One download, then offline forever. The voice M1K3 was meant to have.

key: A warm, natural neural voice that runs entirely on your device. One download, then offline forever. The voice M1K3 was meant to have.
value: Una voz neuronal cálida y natural que funciona por completo en tu dispositivo. Una sola descarga y, después, sin conexión para siempre. La voz que M1K3 siempre debió tener.
english: A warm, natural neural voice that runs entirely on your device. One download, then offline forever. The voice M1K3 was meant to have.

key: Speech recognition isn't allowed — check Settings › Privacy & Security.
value: El reconocimiento de voz no está permitido: revisa Ajustes › Privacidad y seguridad.
note: This one string serves macOS and iOS (AppleSpeechTranscriber.swift:456 has no #if). 'Ajustes › Privacidad y seguridad' is the exact path on iOS. On a Spanish Mac the app is called 'Ajustes del Sistema', so the Mac text is a little short, the same way the English 'Settings' is. A native reader should confirm. Splitting the key per platform would make it exact.
english: Speech recognition isn't allowed — check Settings › Privacy & Security.

key: Your device's built-in speech. Works immediately, always on-device — clear, if a little robotic.
value: La voz integrada de tu dispositivo. Funciona al instante, siempre en el dispositivo: clara, aunque un poco robótica.
note: 'always on-device' → 'siempre en el dispositivo', translated literally.
english: Your device's built-in speech. Works immediately, always on-device — clear, if a little robotic.

key: macOS's built-in speech. Works immediately, always on-device — clear, if a little robotic.
value: La voz integrada de macOS. Funciona al instante, siempre en el dispositivo: clara, aunque un poco robótica.
english: macOS's built-in speech. Works immediately, always on-device — clear, if a little robotic.

key: NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription
value: Quand tu enregistres un appel, M1K3 capte l’audio de ton interlocuteur pour transcrire l’appel sur ton Mac. L’audio ne quitte jamais ton Mac.
note: Privacy copy, translated literally (« ne quitte jamais »). « l’audio de ton interlocuteur » renders 'the other side's audio'.
english: When you record a call, M1K3 captures the other side's audio so it can transcribe the call on your Mac. The audio never leaves your Mac.

key: NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription
value: M1K3 lit tes prochains événements (titres et horaires) pour ancrer ses réponses — uniquement tant que l’option de contexte Calendrier est activée. Ils restent sur ce Mac, sauf qu’une recherche web lancée par M1K3 peut inclure des mots qui en proviennent — la recherche web s’active ou se désactive dans les Réglages.
note: Privacy copy. 'only while' = « uniquement tant que ». The exception for web search is kept as strong as the English. « l’option de contexte Calendrier » should match whatever the French UI calls the Calendar context toggle once that string is translated.
english: M1K3 reads your next few events (titles and times) to ground answers — only while the Calendar context toggle is on. They stay on this Mac, except that a web search M1K3 runs can carry words from them — web search is a switch in Settings.

key: NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription
value: Brain at Home met le cerveau de M1K3 à disposition des appareils que tu associes par code QR — uniquement sur ton réseau local, chiffré, désactivé par défaut.
note: Privacy copy. 'only' and 'off by default' are literal (« uniquement », « désactivé par défaut »). « chiffré, désactivé » agree with Brain at Home as masculine, the same as the English list.
english: Brain at Home serves M1K3's brain to devices you pair by QR code — on your local network only, encrypted, off by default.

key: NSLocationUsageDescription
value: M1K3 utilise ta localisation — une zone approximative d’environ 10 km, sauf si tu choisis la position exacte — pour ancrer ses réponses, uniquement tant que l’option de contexte Localisation est activée. Elle reste sur ce Mac, sauf qu’une recherche web lancée par M1K3 peut l’inclure — la recherche web s’active ou se désactive dans les Réglages.
note: Privacy copy. There is a U+00A0 between 10 and km. 'precise' uses Apple's term, « position exacte ».
english: M1K3 uses your location — a coarse ~10 km area unless you opt up to precise — to ground answers, only while the Location context toggle is on. It stays on this Mac, except that a web search M1K3 runs can carry it — web search is a switch in Settings.

key: NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription
value: M1K3 utilise ta localisation — une zone approximative d’environ 10 km, sauf si tu choisis la position exacte — pour ancrer ses réponses, uniquement tant que l’option de contexte Localisation est activée. Elle reste sur ce Mac, sauf qu’une recherche web lancée par M1K3 peut l’inclure — la recherche web s’active ou se désactive dans les Réglages.
note: Same text as item 3, translated the same way (U+00A0 before km).
english: M1K3 uses your location — a coarse ~10 km area unless you opt up to precise — to ground answers, only while the Location context toggle is on. It stays on this Mac, except that a web search M1K3 runs can carry it — web search is a switch in Settings.

key: NSMicrophoneUsageDescription
value: M1K3 utilise le microphone pour la saisie vocale. L’audio est transcrit sur l’appareil et ne quitte jamais ton Mac.
note: Privacy copy, translated literally.
english: M1K3 uses the microphone for voice input. Audio is transcribed on-device and never leaves your Mac.

key: NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription
value: M1K3 utilise la reconnaissance vocale d’Apple sur l’appareil, donc ta voix reste sur ce Mac. Elle n’est jamais envoyée à un serveur.
note: Privacy copy, translated literally. « Elle » can mean the voice or the recognition, and the English 'It' is just as open, so the meaning is unchanged.
english: M1K3 uses Apple's on-device speech recognition, so your voice stays on this Mac. It is never sent to a server.

key: %@ is thinking · private by design
value: %@ réfléchit · privé par design
english: %@ is thinking · private by design

key: A line about you seeds my memory — "I teach primary school", "short answers, please". It stays on this Mac, and you can edit it any time in Settings → You.
value: Une phrase sur toi alimente ma mémoire — « J’enseigne en primaire », « des réponses courtes, s’il te plaît ». Elle reste sur ce Mac, et tu peux la modifier à tout moment dans Réglages → Toi.
note: Privacy line (stays on this Mac), literal. « Toi » assumes the Settings tab « You » (SettingsView.swift:68) is translated « Toi »; keep the two in step.
english: A line about you seeds my memory — "I teach primary school", "short answers, please". It stays on this Mac, and you can edit it any time in Settings → You.

key: A serif face; some readers find the strokes easier to track.
value: Une police à empattements ; certaines personnes suivent plus facilement ses traits.
note: review kept true because the batch flags it; the line itself is not privacy copy.
english: A serif face; some readers find the strokes easier to track.

key: A testing aid: shows context tokens and tokens/sec under each answer from Lil or Big. Mini (Apple's on-device model) doesn't report generation metrics.
value: Une aide aux tests : affiche les tokens de contexte et les tokens/s sous chaque réponse de Lil ou Big. Mini (le modèle sur l’appareil d’Apple) ne fournit pas de statistiques de génération.
note: « aide au test » → « aide aux tests » (the idiomatic plural).
english: A testing aid: shows context tokens and tokens/sec under each answer from Lil or Big. Mini (Apple's on-device model) doesn't report generation metrics.

key: Add one above. M1K3 and connected agents can suggest todos; suggestions wait here for your say-so.
value: Ajoutes-en une ci-dessus. M1K3 et les agents connectés peuvent suggérer des tâches ; les suggestions attendent ici ton feu vert.
english: Add one above. M1K3 and connected agents can suggest todos; suggestions wait here for your say-so.

key: Agent Log — MCP tool calls captured from connected agents (opt-in)
value: Journal des agents — appels d’outils MCP enregistrés depuis les agents connectés (à activer)
note: Says what is captured from connected agents. 'captés auprès des' read oddly, so it is now 'enregistrés depuis les'. 'opt-in' is 'à activer' (off until you turn it on). The batch flag was false; set to true because the line says what is recorded.
english: Agent Log — MCP tool calls captured from connected agents (opt-in)

key: Also send this conversation
value: Envoyer aussi cette conversation
note: Private Cloud consent toggle, translated literally. 'conversation' follows the term table.
english: Also send this conversation

key: Also serve MCP tools to paired devices
value: Proposer aussi les outils MCP aux appareils associés
note: Says which devices get the MCP tools. The batch flag was false; kept true.
english: Also serve MCP tools to paired devices

key: Apple Intelligence isn't available here, so I'll fetch my own brain — %@ M1K3, a one-time %@ download. Still fully on this Mac.
value: Apple Intelligence n’est pas disponible ici, alors je vais récupérer mon propre cerveau — %1$@ M1K3, un téléchargement unique de %2$@. Toujours entièrement sur ce Mac.
note: %1$@ is the tier name (Lil/Big) and %2$@ the download size. 'Still fully on this Mac' is kept literal.
english: Apple Intelligence isn't available here, so I'll fetch my own brain — %1$@ M1K3, a one-time %2$@ download. Still fully on this Mac.

key: Apple Intelligence isn’t available on this Mac. M1K3’s own Mini runs here after a one-time download.
value: Apple Intelligence n’est pas disponible sur ce Mac. Le Mini propre à M1K3 fonctionne ici après un téléchargement unique.
note: 'own' had been lost ('Le Mini de M1K3'). Restored as 'Le Mini propre à M1K3' so the line still contrasts with Apple's model.
english: Apple Intelligence isn’t available on this Mac. M1K3’s own Mini runs here after a one-time download.

key: Ask M1K3 a question and get a grounded answer from your local knowledge.
value: Pose une question à M1K3 et obtiens une réponse ancrée dans tes connaissances locales.
english: Ask M1K3 a question and get a grounded answer from your local knowledge.

key: Built-in is Apple's default voice. M1K3 Voice downloads a neural voice model and runs entirely offline. Character shapes the tone — Clean is the full range, M1K3 is the signature sound, Radio leans lo-fi. Hit “Hear a sample” to compare.
value: « Intégrée » est la voix par défaut d’Apple. M1K3 Voice télécharge un modèle de voix neuronal et fonctionne entièrement hors ligne. Le caractère façonne le ton — Claire couvre tout le spectre, M1K3 est la signature sonore, Radio tire vers le lo-fi. Clique sur « Écouter un extrait » pour comparer.
note: The Voice catalog draft renders the character option 'Clean' as « Claire » (Sources/M1K3Voice VoiceCharacter.displayName is localized), so this footer names it Claire to match the picker. If that option stays 'Clean', change it back here too. 'Clean is the full range' = full frequency range, so 'couvre tout le spectre' (not 'toute la gamme'). Matches 'Hear a sample' = « Écouter un extrait » and 'Built-in' = Intégrée elsewhere. Mac pane: 'Clique sur'. NBSP inside « ».
english: Built-in is Apple's default voice. M1K3 Voice downloads a neural voice model and runs entirely offline. Character shapes the tone — Clean is the full range, M1K3 is the signature sound, Radio leans lo-fi. Hit “Hear a sample” to compare.

key: Calendar (titles & times)
value: Calendrier (titres et heures)
note: Context consent toggle: what the model may see from the calendar.
english: Calendar (titles & times)

key: Clear every pulse (agent-call history is cleared in the Agent Log)
value: Effacer tous les bilans (l’historique des appels d’agents s’efface depuis le Journal des agents)
english: Clear every pulse (agent-call history is cleared in the Agent Log)

key: Couldn’t save a new key to the Keychain. The current one still works.
value: Impossible d’enregistrer une nouvelle clé dans le trousseau. La clé actuelle fonctionne toujours.
english: Couldn’t save a new key to the Keychain. The current one still works.

key: Couldn’t save a new token to the Keychain. The current one still works.
value: Impossible d’enregistrer un nouveau jeton dans le trousseau. Le jeton actuel fonctionne toujours.
english: Couldn’t save a new token to the Keychain. The current one still works.

key: Discard dictation — nothing is sent
value: Abandonner la dictée — rien n’est envoyé
english: Discard dictation — nothing is sent

key: Downloads come from huggingface.co (and github.com for the voice pack), once, and then run on this Mac. Nothing is removed without asking.
value: Les téléchargements viennent de huggingface.co (et de github.com pour le pack de voix), une seule fois, puis tournent sur ce Mac. Rien n’est supprimé sans te le demander.
english: Downloads come from huggingface.co (and github.com for the voice pack), once, and then run on this Mac. Nothing is removed without asking.

key: Dress M1K3 up for the occasional holiday — Halloween, and flight colours while you are offline.
value: Habiller M1K3 à l’occasion de certaines fêtes — Halloween, et des couleurs d’aviation quand tu es hors ligne.
note: 'flight colours' is the Flight Club seasonal look (a runway-blue lattice, SiteFoxPaint.swift:11) shown while offline / in Airplane Mode. 'couleurs de vol' was a calque; 'couleurs d’aviation' reads naturally. A native reader may prefer naming the event (« aux couleurs du Flight Club »).
english: Dress M1K3 up for the occasional holiday — Halloween, and flight colours while you are offline.

key: Drop a PDF or text file on the window, or activate to pick one. Files are read on this Mac only.
value: Dépose un PDF ou un fichier texte sur la fenêtre, ou active ce bouton pour en choisir un. Les fichiers sont lus sur ce Mac uniquement.
note: VoiceOver label on a button (GreetingCard.swift:153). The bare 'ou active pour…' had no object in French; 'active ce bouton' makes the hint read. 'only' kept literal (uniquement).
english: Drop a PDF or text file on the window, or activate to pick one. Files are read on this Mac only.

key: Drop or import a PDF or text file and it'll appear here. Photos you ask me to remember appear too; their descriptions stay on this device.
value: Dépose ou importe un PDF ou un fichier texte et il apparaîtra ici. Les photos que tu me demandes de mémoriser apparaissent aussi ; leurs descriptions restent sur cet appareil.
note: Non-breaking space (U+00A0) before the semicolon.
english: Drop or import a PDF or text file and it'll appear here. Photos you ask me to remember appear too; their descriptions stay on this device.

key: Email this one exchange to Round Tower — you see the exact text first
value: Envoyer ce seul échange par e-mail à Round Tower — tu vois d’abord le texte exact
note: Says what leaves the device, so flagged for review although the batch had review:false. 'this one exchange' stresses that only this exchange is sent: 'ce seul échange' keeps that limit (the draft's 'cet échange' lost it). Round Tower is a company name, kept.
english: Email this one exchange to Round Tower — you see the exact text first

key: Every agent you’ve connected stops reaching M1K3 until you connect it again with the new token.
value: Chaque agent que tu as connecté ne peut plus joindre M1K3 tant que tu ne le reconnectes pas avec le nouveau jeton.
english: Every agent you’ve connected stops reaching M1K3 until you connect it again with the new token.

key: Every app you’ve pointed at M1K3 stops working until you give it the new key.
value: Chaque app que tu as reliée à M1K3 cesse de fonctionner tant que tu ne lui donnes pas la nouvelle clé.
english: Every app you’ve pointed at M1K3 stops working until you give it the new key.

key: Every couple of hours M1K3 can take stock — what it learned, who called in, how the machine is doing — and write a short note. Turn it on in Settings → M1K3. Kept on this machine only.
value: Toutes les deux heures environ, M1K3 peut faire le point — ce qu’il a appris, qui est passé, comment va la machine — et écrire un court bilan. Active-le dans Réglages → M1K3. Conservé sur cette machine uniquement.
note: 'Settings → M1K3': the pane is named M1K3, so only Settings is translated.
english: Every couple of hours M1K3 can take stock — what it learned, who called in, how the machine is doing — and write a short note. Turn it on in Settings → M1K3. Kept on this machine only.

key: Every couple of hours M1K3 takes stock and writes a short note. Kept on this machine, capped at a week, never remembered as facts.
value: Toutes les deux heures environ, M1K3 fait le point et écrit un court bilan. Conservé sur cette machine, limité à une semaine, jamais mémorisé comme des faits.
english: Every couple of hours M1K3 takes stock and writes a short note. Kept on this machine, capped at a week, never remembered as facts.

key: Exports every remembered fact as plain-text Markdown. Outside M1K3 this folder is not encrypted — it's yours to guard.
value: Exporte chaque fait mémorisé en Markdown (texte brut). En dehors de M1K3, ce dossier n’est pas chiffré — c’est à toi de le protéger.
note: 'en Markdown, en texte brut' read as two formats; 'plain-text Markdown' is one format, so the gloss goes in parentheses. 'not encrypted' kept literal.
english: Exports every remembered fact as plain-text Markdown. Outside M1K3 this folder is not encrypted — it's yours to guard.

key: Forget this — removes it everywhere, no residue
value: Oublier ceci — le supprime partout, sans aucune trace
english: Forget this — removes it everywhere, no residue

key: Full transcript in the Agent Log
value: Transcription complète dans le Journal des agents
english: Full transcript in the Agent Log

key: How Apple protects it
value: Comment Apple protège ce que tu envoies
note: Changed from 'tes données'. In the sheet, 'it' points at PrivateCloudTurn.appleGuarantee ('what you send'), so the link now says exactly that and claims nothing broader. Same link in the Privacy pane footer.
english: How Apple protects it

key: How you asked M1K3 to answer. The newest asks shape every answer on this Mac, as many as fit.
value: Comment tu as demandé à M1K3 de répondre. Les demandes les plus récentes façonnent chaque réponse sur ce Mac, autant que la place le permet.
english: How you asked M1K3 to answer. The newest asks shape every answer on this Mac, as many as fit.

key: I hit a snag last time. Send Round Tower a short report? You'll see it first.
value: J’ai eu un pépin la dernière fois. Envoyer un court rapport à Round Tower ? Tu le verras d’abord.
note: Changed 'J’ai rencontré un problème' to the more casual 'J’ai eu un pépin', which is closer to 'hit a snag'. Round Tower stays as is. The promise 'You'll see it first' is kept word for word.
english: I hit a snag last time. Send Round Tower a short report? You'll see it first.

key: I remember things — properly, on this Mac.
value: Je retiens les choses — pour de vrai, sur ce Mac.
english: I remember things — properly, on this Mac.

key: Include on-device crash/hang summaries
value: Inclure les résumés de plantages et blocages enregistrés sur l’appareil
note: Changed 'établis' to 'enregistrés' (recorded), which says plainly that the summaries come from the device. The toggle adds them to an outgoing issue report, so it stays flagged for review. It runs longer than the English, but it is a settings toggle and has room.
english: Include on-device crash/hang summaries

key: Keep it on this Mac
value: Garder sur ce Mac
note: Cancel button in two places: the field report sheet ('it' is the report, masculine) and the Private Cloud consent sheet ('it' is the request, feminine). The pronoun is dropped so one string fits both. The promise (it stays on this Mac) is intact.
english: Keep it on this Mac

key: Let agents delete memories
value: Autoriser les agents à supprimer des souvenirs
english: Let agents delete memories

key: Let agents open links on screen
value: Autoriser les agents à ouvrir des liens à l’écran
note: Batch said review:false; kept true because this toggle asks permission for connected agents (same group as items 2 and 4).
english: Let agents open links on screen

key: Let agents use the microphone
value: Autoriser les agents à utiliser le micro
english: Let agents use the microphone

key: Lets M1K3 ground answers in the moment — battery, your next events, where you are (a coarse ~10 km area unless Precise is on). Snapshots only: never remembered, never mixed with web tools in a turn. macOS asks its own permission when you switch Calendar or Location on.
value: Permet à M1K3 d’ancrer ses réponses dans l’instant — batterie, tes prochains événements, l’endroit où tu te trouves (une zone approximative d’environ 10 km, sauf si « Position exacte » est activée). Des instantanés uniquement : jamais mémorisés, jamais mêlés aux outils web dans un même échange. macOS demande sa propre autorisation quand tu actives Calendrier ou Localisation.
note: 'Precise' is the 'Precise location' toggle (PrivacySettingsPane.swift:273), so it reads « Position exacte »; 'Calendar' and 'Location' name toggles. Keep these in step with how those toggles are translated ('Calendar (titles & times)' → Calendrier…). Non-breaking spaces before ':' and inside « », and in '10 km'.
english: Lets M1K3 ground answers in the moment — battery, your next events, where you are (a coarse ~10 km area unless Precise is on). Snapshots only: never remembered, never mixed with web tools in a turn. macOS asks its own permission when you switch Calendar or Location on.

key: Lets an agent on this Mac use M1K3's knowledge, memory and voice. Loopback-only, one client at a time. An agent needs the access token to connect. Listening, deleting memories and opening links stay off until you allow them.
value: Permet à un agent sur ce Mac d’utiliser les connaissances, la mémoire et la voix de M1K3. Uniquement en local (loopback), un client à la fois. Un agent a besoin du jeton d’accès pour se connecter. L’écoute, la suppression de souvenirs et l’ouverture de liens restent désactivées jusqu’à ce que tu les autorises.
note: Changed 'Boucle locale uniquement': in French networking « boucle locale » means the telecom local loop (the last mile to the home), so it was a false friend. Now « Uniquement en local (loopback) »; a native reader should confirm.
english: Lets an agent on this Mac use M1K3's knowledge, memory and voice. Loopback-only, one client at a time. An agent needs the access token to connect. Listening, deleting memories and opening links stay off until you allow them.

key: Lets other apps on this Mac use the brain M1K3 has loaded, with their own instructions: no M1K3 personality, memory, knowledge or tools, and nothing they send is kept. Point any OpenAI-compatible tool at the base URL and use the API key. Loopback-only, one call at a time, and you always go first. M1K3's brains are chosen and tested inside M1K3; how one behaves under another app's instructions is for you to judge.
value: Permet aux autres apps de ce Mac d’utiliser le cerveau chargé par M1K3, avec leurs propres instructions : sans la personnalité, la mémoire, les connaissances ni les outils de M1K3, et rien de ce qu’elles envoient n’est conservé. Pointe n’importe quel outil compatible OpenAI vers l’URL de base et utilise la clé API. Uniquement en local (loopback), un appel à la fois, et tu passes toujours en premier. Les cerveaux de M1K3 sont choisis et testés dans M1K3 ; c’est à toi de juger comment l’un d’eux se comporte avec les instructions d’une autre app.
note: Same loopback fix as item 6. Non-breaking spaces before ':' and ';'.
english: Lets other apps on this Mac use the brain M1K3 has loaded, with their own instructions: no M1K3 personality, memory, knowledge or tools, and nothing they send is kept. Point any OpenAI-compatible tool at the base URL and use the API key. Loopback-only, one call at a time, and you always go first. M1K3's brains are chosen and tested inside M1K3; how one behaves under another app's instructions is for you to judge.

key: Local API
value: Local API
english: Local API

key: Local API (OpenAI-compatible, localhost)
value: Local API (compatible OpenAI, localhost)
english: Local API (OpenAI-compatible, localhost)

key: Logging is on. As a connected agent calls M1K3's tools, the requests and responses will appear here.
value: La journalisation est activée. À mesure qu’un agent connecté appelle les outils de M1K3, les requêtes et les réponses s’afficheront ici.
note: Changed: 'As … calls' → « À mesure que » and 'will appear' → future « s’afficheront ». Review kept true because it says what is captured. The batch said false, and a human may lower it.
english: Logging is on. As a connected agent calls M1K3's tools, the requests and responses will appear here.

key: Looking at what's already on this Mac…
value: Je regarde ce qui se trouve déjà sur ce Mac…
note: First person to match the neighbouring kitNote ('You already have everything I can fetch here').
english: Looking at what's already on this Mac…

key: M1K3 doesn't capture agent conversations by default. Turn on “Log agent conversations” in Settings → Server to review what a connected agent asks for and hears back — on this Mac only.
value: Par défaut, M1K3 n’enregistre pas les conversations des agents. Active « Journaliser les conversations des agents » dans Réglages → Serveur pour consulter ce qu’un agent connecté demande et ce qu’on lui répond — sur ce Mac uniquement.
note: The quoted toggle name must match item 18 exactly. Non-breaking spaces inside « ».
english: M1K3 doesn't capture agent conversations by default. Turn on “Log agent conversations” in Settings → Server to review what a connected agent asks for and hears back — on this Mac only.

key: M1K3 extracts durable facts about you — preferences, decisions, people — from conversations, on-device. Review and erase anytime.
value: M1K3 extrait des faits durables sur toi — préférences, décisions, personnes — de tes conversations, sur l’appareil. Consulte-les et efface-les à tout moment.
english: M1K3 extracts durable facts about you — preferences, decisions, people — from conversations, on-device. Review and erase anytime.

key: M1K3 is built with open-source components. Everything runs on this Mac.
value: M1K3 est conçu avec des composants open source. Tout s’exécute sur ce Mac.
note: 'open source' describes the components only, not M1K3 itself (which is source-available).
english: M1K3 is built with open-source components. Everything runs on this Mac.

key: M1K3 keeps your words on this Mac — ask it anything.
value: M1K3 garde tes mots sur ce Mac — pose-lui n’importe quelle question.
english: M1K3 keeps your words on this Mac — ask it anything.

key: M1K3 won't open a page on this Mac or a private network.
value: M1K3 n’ouvre pas de page située sur ce Mac ou sur un réseau privé.
english: M1K3 won't open a page on this Mac or a private network.

key: M1K3's "hands" — it can only propose a script; every install and approval is your click, and only the exact approved bytes ever run. Script output can't reach the web tools in the same turn and never becomes a remembered fact. An approved script can be re-run later with different input, so approve only scripts you trust with anything.
value: Les « mains » de M1K3 — il peut seulement proposer un script ; chaque installation et chaque approbation passent par ton clic, et seuls les octets exacts que tu as approuvés s’exécutent. La sortie d’un script ne peut pas atteindre les outils web dans le même échange et ne devient jamais un fait mémorisé. Un script approuvé peut être relancé plus tard avec d’autres entrées, alors n’approuve que des scripts auxquels tu ferais confiance quelle que soit l’entrée.
note: The batch said review:false. Set to true because it says what runs and what never becomes memory. 'only' and 'never' are kept literal. Non-breaking spaces inside « » and before ';'.
english: M1K3's "hands" — it can only propose a script; every install and approval is your click, and only the exact approved bytes ever run. Script output can't reach the web tools in the same turn and never becomes a remembered fact. An approved script can be re-run later with different input, so approve only scripts you trust with anything.

key: MCP server (HTTP, localhost)
value: Serveur MCP (HTTP, localhost)
english: MCP server (HTTP, localhost)

key: Make a new API key?
value: Créer une nouvelle clé API ?
english: Make a new API key?

key: Needs Private Cloud Compute on in Settings ▸ Privacy.
value: Nécessite que Private Cloud Compute soit activé dans Réglages ▸ Confidentialité.
english: Needs Private Cloud Compute on in Settings ▸ Privacy.

key: No third-party licenses found.
