value: Aucune licence tierce trouvée.
english: No third-party licenses found.

key: Notch HUD, heartbeat, senses, Private Cloud Compute (asks per message) — all on.
value: HUD de l’encoche, Pouls, sens, Private Cloud Compute (demande à chaque message) — tout est activé.
english: Notch HUD, heartbeat, senses, Private Cloud Compute (asks per message) — all on.

key: Off by default. When on, M1K3 keeps the last 500 tool calls a connected agent makes — see them in Window → Agent Log, or the Heartbeat timeline.
value: Désactivé par défaut. Une fois activé, M1K3 conserve les 500 derniers appels d’outil effectués par un agent connecté — consulte-les dans Fenêtre → Journal des agents, ou dans la chronologie du Pouls.
note: Says what M1K3 keeps and that it is off by default, so flagged for review. 'Window' menu = Fenêtre (macOS).
english: Off by default. When on, M1K3 keeps the last 500 tool calls a connected agent makes — see them in Window → Agent Log, or the Heartbeat timeline.

key: Off unless you turn it on. Then Private Cloud Compute joins the brain picker, and once you pick it, it stays picked until you choose a brain on this Mac. The first time, you see exactly what goes before it goes, and each answer is labelled.
value: Désactivé tant que tu ne l’actives pas. Private Cloud Compute rejoint alors le sélecteur de cerveau, et une fois que tu l’as choisi, il reste sélectionné jusqu’à ce que tu choisisses un cerveau sur ce Mac. La première fois, tu vois exactement ce qui part avant que ça parte, et chaque réponse est étiquetée.
english: Off unless you turn it on. Then Private Cloud Compute joins the brain picker, and once you pick it, it stays picked until you choose a brain on this Mac. The first time, you see exactly what goes before it goes, and each answer is labelled.

key: One-time downloads. None of your data goes with them.
value: Téléchargements uniques. Aucune de tes données ne part avec eux.
english: One-time downloads. None of your data goes with them.

key: Only approve a device you're holding right now.
value: N’approuve qu’un appareil que tu as en main en ce moment.
note: « à l’instant » often means « just now » (in the past) in French, which would change the instruction; « en ce moment » keeps 'right now'. Pairing approval for Brain at Home, so flagged for review.
english: Only approve a device you're holding right now.

key: PDF or text — read here, never uploaded.
value: PDF ou texte — lu ici, jamais envoyé.
note: 'uploaded' rendered as envoyé (sent off the device); 'never' kept literal.
english: PDF or text — read here, never uploaded.

key: Paused: Private Cloud Compute is off in Settings ▸ Privacy. Turning that on resumes this.
value: En pause : Private Cloud Compute est désactivé dans Réglages ▸ Confidentialité. Dès qu’il sera activé, cette option reprendra.
note: 'this' is the lending toggle, which keeps its stored value while paused (MCPServerSettingsPane.swift:206), so it 'resumes' (reprendra) rather than being re-enabled; the draft's « réactivera » suggested it had been turned off.
english: Paused: Private Cloud Compute is off in Settings ▸ Privacy. Turning that on resumes this.

key: Photo remembered. The caption stays on this device.
value: Photo mémorisée. La légende reste sur cet appareil.
english: Photo remembered. The caption stays on this device.

key: Pings you when a long reply finishes or a brain loads — only while M1K3's in the background, never with the reply itself.
value: T’avertit quand une longue réponse se termine ou qu’un cerveau est chargé — uniquement quand M1K3 est en arrière-plan, jamais avec la réponse elle-même.
note: Says what a notification carries (never the reply itself), so it is flagged for review as privacy copy even though the batch says review:false.
english: Pings you when a long reply finishes or a brain loads — only while M1K3's in the background, never with the reply itself.

key: Private Cloud Compute
value: Private Cloud Compute
english: Private Cloud Compute

key: Private · download & go →
value: Privé · télécharger et c’est parti →
english: Private · download & go →

key: Private →
value: Privé →
english: Private →

key: Puts your document and call titles — never contents or memories — into Spotlight (⌘Space). Managed by macOS; turning off removes everything M1K3 donated.
value: Ajoute les titres de tes documents et de tes appels — jamais leur contenu ni tes souvenirs — à Spotlight (⌘Espace). Géré par macOS ; le désactiver retire tout ce que M1K3 y a ajouté.
note: Says what goes into Spotlight and what never does, so it is privacy copy, translated literally.
english: Puts your document and call titles — never contents or memories — into Spotlight (⌘Space). Managed by macOS; turning off removes everything M1K3 donated.

key: Recall a specific memory from M1K3's private memory graph.
value: Retrouver un souvenir précis dans le graphe de mémoire privé de M1K3.
english: Recall a specific memory from M1K3's private memory graph.

key: Record a call from the chat toolbar (consent-gated). With transcription enabled, a stopped recording is transcribed, summarised, encrypted, and indexed — on-device.
value: Enregistre un appel depuis la barre d’outils de la discussion (soumis au consentement). Si la transcription est activée, l’enregistrement, une fois arrêté, est transcrit, résumé, chiffré et indexé — sur l’appareil.
note: 'consent-gated' is now « soumis au consentement ». The draft's « avec consentement » was weaker than a gate. « un enregistrement arrêté » was reworded so it reads naturally.
english: Record a call from the chat toolbar (consent-gated). With transcription enabled, a stopped recording is transcribed, summarised, encrypted, and indexed — on-device.

key: Remembered on this device
value: Mémorisée sur cet appareil
note: Only used under a remembered photo (RememberPhotoButton.swift:60), so it agrees with « photo » (f.).
english: Remembered on this device

key: Runs on Mini, Apple's on-device model · change anytime in Settings.
value: Fonctionne avec Mini, le modèle d’Apple sur l’appareil · modifiable à tout moment dans Réglages.
note: Marked for review because it makes an on-device claim. « sur l’appareil » is literal.
english: Runs on Mini, Apple's on-device model · change anytime in Settings.

key: Save a fact to M1K3’s private memory.
value: Enregistrer un fait dans la mémoire privée de M1K3.
english: Save a fact to M1K3’s private memory.

key: Scan this in M1K3 on the other device. The code lives for a minute and commits nothing until you approve.
value: Scanne ce code dans M1K3 sur l’autre appareil. Il reste valable une minute et ne valide rien tant que tu n’as pas approuvé.
note: Pairing consent line. Changed « n’engage rien » to « ne valide rien ». Without « à », « n’engage rien » is not idiomatic, and « n’engage à rien » means 'commits you to nothing', which is a different promise. The source has no call sites in the batch.
english: Scan this in M1K3 on the other device. The code lives for a minute and commits nothing until you approve.

key: Search M1K3's local knowledge base for documents, notes, and memories.
value: Chercher des documents, des notes et des souvenirs dans la base de connaissances locale de M1K3.
english: Search M1K3's local knowledge base for documents, notes, and memories.

key: Send a short report to Round Tower?
value: Envoyer un court rapport à Round Tower ?
note: There is a non-breaking space before ?. Round Tower is a company name and is not translated.
english: Send a short report to Round Tower?

key: Send this exchange to Round Tower?
value: Envoyer cet échange à Round Tower ?
note: There is a non-breaking space before ?.
english: Send this exchange to Round Tower?

key: Send to Private Cloud Compute
value: Envoyer à Private Cloud Compute
english: Send to Private Cloud Compute

key: Send to Private Cloud Compute?
value: Envoyer à Private Cloud Compute ?
note: Non-breaking space (U+00A0) before ? per the French typography rule.
english: Send to Private Cloud Compute?

key: Serve my brain to my devices
value: Partager mon cerveau avec mes appareils
note: Review set to true: this is the Brain at Home toggle that sends generation off this Mac to paired devices, which the glossary lists as privacy copy. 'Serve' is rendered as 'partager … avec' (share with). A native speaker should confirm this does not read as broader than 'serve'.
english: Serve my brain to my devices

key: Serves raw generation to devices you pair by QR code — local network only, encrypted with a key that never travels the network; no persona, memory, or documents included. The MCP toggle adds read-only tools (search, documents, ask) — asks can reach the web when the web-search toggle allows. Off by default; revoking a device cuts it off immediately.
value: Fournit la génération brute aux appareils que tu associes par code QR — réseau local uniquement, chiffrée avec une clé qui ne transite jamais sur le réseau ; ni personnalité, ni mémoire, ni documents ne sont inclus. L’option MCP ajoute des outils en lecture seule (recherche, documents, question) — les questions peuvent accéder au web quand l’option de recherche web le permet. Désactivé par défaut ; révoquer un appareil le déconnecte immédiatement.
note: Privacy copy, translated literally. 'no persona, memory, or documents included' is now a full clause, so it no longer reads as a dangling participle. 'cuts it off' = le déconnecte. The tool names (search, documents, ask) are given as descriptive words; keep the English tool ids instead if the UI shows them elsewhere. Uses U+00A0 before both semicolons.
english: Serves raw generation to devices you pair by QR code — local network only, encrypted with a key that never travels the network; no persona, memory, or documents included. The MCP toggle adds read-only tools (search, documents, ask) — asks can reach the web when the web-search toggle allows. Off by default; revoking a device cuts it off immediately.

key: Serving on :%@ to ^[%@ paired device](inflect: true)
value: En service sur :%1$@ pour ^[%2$@ appareil associé](inflect: true)
english: Serving on :%1$@ to ^[%2$@ paired device](inflect: true)

key: Shared from M1K3 · m1k3.app
value: Partagé depuis M1K3 · m1k3.app
english: Shared from M1K3 · m1k3.app

key: Short earcons for errors, saved memories, and voice mode waking up — never over M1K3's voice. The dial-up sound plays while a brain loads and has its own switch since it loops.
value: De courts signaux sonores pour les erreurs, les souvenirs enregistrés et le réveil du mode vocal — jamais par-dessus la voix de M1K3. Le son de connexion du modem est joué pendant le chargement d’un cerveau et a sa propre option, car il tourne en boucle.
english: Short earcons for errors, saved memories, and voice mode waking up — never over M1K3's voice. The dial-up sound plays while a brain loads and has its own switch since it loops.

key: Show documents & calls in Spotlight
value: Afficher les documents et les appels dans Spotlight
note: Review set to true: a Privacy pane toggle that decides whether documents and call records show up in system-wide search (who sees it).
english: Show documents & calls in Spotlight

key: Show exactly what that sends
value: Afficher exactement ce que cela envoie
note: Disclosure under 'Also send this conversation'. Changed to the literal 'what that sends'. The draft's 'ce qui est envoyé' implied the content had already been sent.
english: Show exactly what that sends

key: Start a fresh conversation — this one stays in Conversations (⌘N)
value: Commencer une nouvelle conversation — celle-ci reste dans Conversations (⌘N)
english: Start a fresh conversation — this one stays in Conversations (⌘N)

key: Stops listening without sending
value: Arrête l’écoute sans envoyer
note: VoiceOver hint on the Discard dictation button, in the third-person hint form.
english: Stops listening without sending

key: Suggestions from M1K3 and connected agents land in your inbox as pending. Only you can accept or close a todo.
value: Les suggestions de M1K3 et des agents connectés arrivent dans ta boîte de réception, en attente. Il n’y a que toi qui peux accepter ou clore une tâche.
note: Flagged for review: 'Only you can accept or close' is a promise about what connected agents cannot do, and « Il n’y a que toi qui » keeps the full force of 'only' with no gender. The text is unchanged.
english: Suggestions from M1K3 and connected agents land in your inbox as pending. Only you can accept or close a todo.

key: Tap Record to capture a call, or import a transcript (lines like “Speaker: …”). M1K3 summarises it, encrypts it at rest, and makes it searchable alongside your documents.
value: Touche Enregistrer pour capturer un appel, ou importe une transcription (des lignes comme « Intervenant : … »). M1K3 la résume, la conserve chiffrée et la rend accessible à la recherche, aux côtés de tes documents.
note: « Enregistrer » assumes the 'Record' key (CallsView/MenuBarPopover) is translated as Enregistrer. « Intervenant » is safe: TranscriptImporter.parseLine accepts any short label before a colon, so it does not need the English word 'Speaker', and it trims the non-breaking space. 'encrypts it at rest' became « la conserve chiffrée »: the same promise, but plainer than the jargon « chiffre au repos ». 'makes it searchable alongside' was reworded, because « chercher avec tes documents » read as 'search by means of your documents'.
english: Tap Record to capture a call, or import a transcript (lines like “Speaker: …”). M1K3 summarises it, encrypts it at rest, and makes it searchable alongside your documents.

key: The exact text that will be sent
value: Le texte exact qui sera envoyé
english: The exact text that will be sent

key: The list couldn't be opened on this Mac.
value: La liste n’a pas pu être ouverte sur ce Mac.
english: The list couldn't be opened on this Mac.

key: The pairing code expired.
value: Le code d’association a expiré.
english: The pairing code expired.

key: This is the whole message: that M1K3 didn't close cleanly last time, when that session began, the brain, the app and macOS versions, and any crash summaries this Mac kept. Nothing you typed or said goes with it. It goes to %@ from your own mail app, which opens with it filled in. M1K3 sends nothing itself. Round Tower reads it to find what went wrong, and deletes it if you ask. If you remember what you were doing, add it at the end: that helps most.
value: Voici le message en entier : le fait que M1K3 ne s’est pas fermé correctement la dernière fois, le moment où cette session-là a commencé, le cerveau, les versions de l’app et de macOS, et les éventuels résumés de plantage que ce Mac a conservés. Rien de ce que tu as tapé ou dit ne l’accompagne. Il est envoyé à %@ depuis ta propre app de messagerie, qui s’ouvre avec le message déjà rempli. M1K3 n’envoie rien lui-même. Round Tower le lit pour trouver ce qui n’a pas marché, et le supprime si tu le demandes. Si tu te souviens de ce que tu faisais, ajoute-le à la fin : c’est ce qui aide le plus.
note: Privacy copy, translated literally. « cette session-là » makes clear it is the session that crashed, not the current one. « éventuels » carries 'any' (there may be none). « ta propre app de messagerie » is any mail app, not Apple's Mail.
english: This is the whole message: that M1K3 didn't close cleanly last time, when that session began, the brain, the app and macOS versions, and any crash summaries this Mac kept. Nothing you typed or said goes with it. It goes to %@ from your own mail app, which opens with it filled in. M1K3 sends nothing itself. Round Tower reads it to find what went wrong, and deletes it if you ask. If you remember what you were doing, add it at the end: that helps most.

key: This is the whole message: your message, M1K3's answer, your note, the brain and the app version — nothing else from this Mac, though the answer may quote what M1K3 read to write it. It goes to %@ from your own mail app, which opens with it filled in. M1K3 sends nothing itself. Round Tower reads it to fix what went wrong, may rewrite it as a made-up test case, and deletes it if you ask. Change anything below first if you like.
value: Voici le message en entier : ton message, la réponse de M1K3, ta note, le cerveau et la version de l’app — rien d’autre de ce Mac, même si la réponse peut citer ce que M1K3 a lu pour l’écrire. Il est envoyé à %@ depuis ta propre app de messagerie, qui s’ouvre avec le message déjà rempli. M1K3 n’envoie rien lui-même. Round Tower le lit pour corriger ce qui n’a pas marché, peut le réécrire sous forme de cas de test fictif, et le supprime si tu le demandes. Tu peux d’abord modifier ce que tu veux ci-dessous.
note: Privacy copy, translated literally. 'made-up' became « fictif ». The last sentence no longer says 'if you want' twice (« ce que tu veux… si tu le souhaites »).
english: This is the whole message: your message, M1K3's answer, your note, the brain and the app version — nothing else from this Mac, though the answer may quote what M1K3 read to write it. It goes to %@ from your own mail app, which opens with it filled in. M1K3 sends nothing itself. Round Tower reads it to fix what went wrong, may rewrite it as a made-up test case, and deletes it if you ask. Change anything below first if you like.

key: This page tried to send the panel to a file on this Mac or a private-network address. M1K3 won’t open those on a page’s say-so.
value: Cette page a essayé de rediriger le panneau vers un fichier de ce Mac ou une adresse de réseau privé. M1K3 ne les ouvre pas sur simple demande d’une page.
note: 'send the panel to' means navigate it, so « rediriger » fits better than « envoyer », which read as sending data.
english: This page tried to send the panel to a file on this Mac or a private-network address. M1K3 won’t open those on a page’s say-so.

key: Unavailable — the Keychain couldn’t be read
value: Indisponible — impossible de lire le trousseau
english: Unavailable — the Keychain couldn’t be read

key: Uses Apple's Declared Age Range to adjust content for younger users. Web search is disabled for users under 16; the assistant's tone adjusts for all minors. Declining gives full capability.
value: S’appuie sur la Tranche d’âge déclarée d’Apple pour adapter le contenu aux plus jeunes. La recherche web est désactivée pour les moins de 16 ans ; le ton de l’assistant s’adapte pour tous les mineurs. Refuser donne accès à toutes les fonctionnalités.
note: Changed the opening « Utilise » to « S’appuie sur »: with tu register, « Utilise … » reads as an instruction to the user (imperative) rather than a description of the feature. Declared Age Range name (« Tranche d’âge déclarée ») still to confirm against Apple’s fr string.
english: Uses Apple's Declared Age Range to adjust content for younger users. Web search is disabled for users under 16; the assistant's tone adjusts for all minors. Declining gives full capability.

key: Web search is off: M1K3 won't search the web. Click to turn it on.
value: La recherche web est désactivée : M1K3 ne cherchera pas sur le web. Clique pour l’activer.
english: Web search is off: M1K3 won't search the web. Click to turn it on.

key: Web search is on: M1K3 can send a search to %@. Click to turn it off.
value: La recherche web est activée : M1K3 peut envoyer une recherche à %@. Clique pour la désactiver.
note: %@ is the search provider name (e.g. DuckDuckGo).
english: Web search is on: M1K3 can send a search to %@. Click to turn it off.

key: Web search isn't available here.
value: La recherche web n’est pas disponible ici.
english: Web search isn't available here.

key: What M1K3 knows about you — it rides every conversation's system prompt. Stored on this machine only, never retrieved or cited, yours to edit or clear.
value: Ce que M1K3 sait de toi — c’est inclus dans l’invite système de chaque conversation. Stocké uniquement sur cette machine, jamais récupéré ni cité, à toi de le modifier ou de l’effacer.
note: "retrieved" is the RAG sense (never pulled in by search); « récupéré » kept literal, but it can read as « fetched/taken back ». A native reader may prefer « jamais retrouvé par la recherche ni cité »; that is a privacy-copy call for the human pass.
english: What M1K3 knows about you — it rides every conversation's system prompt. Stored on this machine only, never retrieved or cited, yours to edit or clear.

key: When the Agent Interaction Log is on, calls from connected agents fold into this timeline as visits — who called in, and what they used. Captured on this Mac only, newest 500 kept, off by default.
value: Quand le Journal des interactions des agents est activé, les appels des agents connectés s’intègrent à cette chronologie sous forme de visites — qui est passé et ce qu’il a utilisé. Enregistrement uniquement sur ce Mac, les 500 plus récentes conservées, désactivé par défaut.
note: Fixed the gender clash in the last sentence: the draft had « Enregistrées » (visits, f.) beside « désactivé » (log, m.). The nominal « Enregistrement » now carries both. 'only' = uniquement, 'off by default' kept literal. The toggle above it is « Journaliser les conversations des agents » and the window is « Journal des agents ». Check that « Journal des interactions des agents » doesn't read as a third feature name.
english: When the Agent Interaction Log is on, calls from connected agents fold into this timeline as visits — who called in, and what they used. Captured on this Mac only, newest 500 kept, off by default.

key: Write a short description of this photo and remember it. The description stays on this device.
value: Rédiger une courte description de cette photo et la mémoriser. La description reste sur cet appareil.
note: This is the button's help tag. It uses the infinitive because the button does the writing, not the person.
english: Write a short description of this photo and remember it. The description stays on this device.

key: Writes a short description and remembers it on this device
value: Rédige une courte description et la mémorise sur cet appareil
note: VoiceOver hint in the third person, describing what the button does.
english: Writes a short description and remembers it on this device

key: Your Mac is blocking Speech Recognition for M1K3. Flip it on in System Settings, then try me again.
value: Ton Mac bloque la Reconnaissance vocale pour M1K3. Active-la dans Réglages Système, puis réessaie.
note: Review is now true: it is permission guidance, the same as the calendar and location lines.
english: Your Mac is blocking Speech Recognition for M1K3. Flip it on in System Settings, then try me again.

key: Your Mac is blocking the mic. Flip M1K3 on in System Settings, then try me again.
value: Ton Mac bloque le micro. Active M1K3 dans Réglages Système, puis réessaie.
note: Review is now true: it is microphone permission guidance.
english: Your Mac is blocking the mic. Flip M1K3 on in System Settings, then try me again.

key: Your next message is answered from this text again, on this Mac
value: La réponse à ton prochain message s’appuiera de nouveau sur ce texte, sur ce Mac
english: Your next message is answered from this text again, on this Mac

key: You’re responsible for having consent from everyone on the call. Recording is on-device only — audio never leaves this Mac.
value: Tu es responsable d’obtenir le consentement de toutes les personnes participant à l’appel. L’enregistrement se fait uniquement sur l’appareil — l’audio ne quitte jamais ce Mac.
english: You’re responsible for having consent from everyone on the call. Recording is on-device only — audio never leaves this Mac.

key: macOS didn't get an answer, so %@ stayed off. Switch it on again to be asked.
value: macOS n’a pas obtenu de réponse, donc l’option « %@ » est restée désactivée. Réactive-la pour qu’on te pose la question.
note: %@ is a raw English literal ("Calendar" / "Location") from PrivacySettingsPane.swift:305/310, and it is not localised. French users will see the English word. « l’option » now carries the agreement, so the line reads correctly whatever the argument's gender. Localise those name: arguments to « Calendrier » / « Localisation », matching the toggles. Review is now true because the line is about a permission prompt.
english: macOS didn't get an answer, so %@ stayed off. Switch it on again to be asked.

key: macOS has calendar access off for M1K3 — grant it in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Calendars, then switch this back on.
value: Dans macOS, l’accès au calendrier est désactivé pour M1K3 — autorise-le dans Réglages Système → Confidentialité et sécurité → Calendriers, puis réactive cette option.
english: macOS has calendar access off for M1K3 — grant it in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Calendars, then switch this back on.

key: macOS has location access off for M1K3 — grant it in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Location Services, then switch this back on.
value: Dans macOS, l’accès à la localisation est désactivé pour M1K3 — autorise-le dans Réglages Système → Confidentialité et sécurité → Service de localisation, puis réactive cette option.
english: macOS has location access off for M1K3 — grant it in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Location Services, then switch this back on.

key: “%@” wants to pair
value: « %@ » veut s’associer
note: Review is now true: it is a Brain at Home pairing request, where a device asks for access.
english: “%@” wants to pair

key: NSCameraUsageDescription
value: M1K3 utilise la caméra pour scanner le code d’association que ton Mac affiche pour Brain at Home, et pour regarder ce vers quoi tu la pointes quand tu le demandes. M1K3 lit ce qu’il voit sur cet appareil et ne l’envoie nulle part. Une image sur laquelle tu poses une question est enregistrée avec cette discussion sur cet appareil.
note: Kept as drafted. It is a literal privacy line: « ne l’envoie nulle part » matches 'sends it nowhere', and 'frame' is « image ». 'camera' is « caméra », as the term table says. Apple’s own French prompts say « appareil photo », but that would clash with « cet appareil » twice in this line. A native reader should confirm both that choice and that « lit ce qu’il voit » reads naturally. The English has the same ambiguity about where 'on this device' attaches.
english: M1K3 uses the camera to scan the pairing code your Mac shows for Brain at Home, and to look at what you point it at when you ask. M1K3 reads what it sees on this device and sends it nowhere. A frame you ask about is saved with that chat on this device.

key: NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription
value: Brain at Home se connecte à ton propre Mac via ton Wi-Fi pour que cet appareil puisse utiliser son cerveau plus gros. Cette connexion reste sur ton propre réseau, chiffrée.
note: Kept as drafted. It is a literal privacy line ('stays on your own network, encrypted'). « son cerveau plus gros » is Big on the Mac. Do not change it to « plus puissant », which would claim more than the English does.
english: Brain at Home connects to your own Mac over your Wi-Fi so this device can use its bigger brain. That connection stays on your own network, encrypted.

key: NSMicrophoneUsageDescription
value: M1K3 utilise le microphone pour les conversations vocales. L’audio est transcrit sur l’appareil et ne quitte jamais ton appareil.
note: Kept as drafted. It is a literal privacy line: 'never' is « ne … jamais ». The English repeats 'device', and so does the French.
english: M1K3 uses the microphone for voice conversations. Audio is transcribed on-device and never leaves your device.

key: NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription
value: M1K3 utilise la reconnaissance vocale d’Apple sur l’appareil, donc ta voix reste sur cet appareil. Elle n’est jamais envoyée à un serveur.
note: Changed « ainsi ta voix reste » to « donc ta voix reste ». Starting a clause with « ainsi » reads stiff in standard French without inversion (« ainsi ta voix reste-t-elle »), and « donc » is the natural 'so'. The privacy force is the same: 'never' is still « n’est jamais ».
english: M1K3 uses Apple's on-device speech recognition, so your voice stays on this device. It is never sent to a server.

key: %@ doesn't run on this device. Staying on Mini.
value: %@ ne fonctionne pas sur cet appareil. On reste sur Mini.
english: %@ doesn't run on this device. Staying on Mini.

key: %@’s brain, over your Wi-Fi
value: Le cerveau de %@, via ton Wi-Fi
english: %@’s brain, over your Wi-Fi

key: %@’s brain, over your Wi‑Fi.
value: Le cerveau de %@, via ton Wi‑Fi.
english: %@’s brain, over your Wi‑Fi.

key: A serif face; some readers find the strokes easier to track.
value: Une police à empattements ; certains lecteurs suivent plus facilement ses traits.
note: 'face' = typeface (police). The batch flags review:true though the line is not privacy copy; kept as flagged.
english: A serif face; some readers find the strokes easier to track.

key: Allow the camera in Settings
value: Autoriser la caméra dans Réglages
note: Glossary uses caméra; Apple's own iOS permission wording says « Appareil photo », so a native reader may prefer « Autoriser l’appareil photo dans Réglages ».
english: Allow the camera in Settings

key: Also send this conversation
value: Envoyer aussi cette conversation
note: Private Cloud consent toggle: literal.
english: Also send this conversation

key: Answers on Apple's servers — asks before your first message goes
value: Répond sur les serveurs d’Apple — demande avant l’envoi de ton premier message
note: Private Cloud detail line, literal.
english: Answers on Apple's servers — asks before your first message goes

key: Answers on Apple's servers. Asks before your first message leaves this device.
value: Répond sur les serveurs d’Apple. Demande avant que ton premier message quitte cet appareil.
english: Answers on Apple's servers. Asks before your first message leaves this device.

key: Apple Intelligence is still getting ready on this device. It can take a while after it's turned on.
value: Apple Intelligence est encore en préparation sur cet appareil. Cela peut prendre un moment après son activation.
english: Apple Intelligence is still getting ready on this device. It can take a while after it's turned on.

key: Apple Intelligence is still getting ready on this device. It can take a while after it's turned on…
value: Apple Intelligence est encore en préparation sur cet appareil. Cela peut prendre un moment après son activation…
english: Apple Intelligence is still getting ready on this device. It can take a while after it's turned on…

key: Brain at Home can't remember photos yet.
value: Brain at Home ne peut pas encore mémoriser de photos.
english: Brain at Home can't remember photos yet.

key: Camera access is off for M1K3
value: L’accès à la caméra est désactivé pour M1K3
english: Camera access is off for M1K3

key: Camera access is off for M1K3.
value: L’accès à la caméra est désactivé pour M1K3.
english: Camera access is off for M1K3.

key: Changes the brain or web search
value: Change le cerveau ou la recherche web
note: VoiceOver hint on the chat status line (third-person hint style, as Apple's French hints).
english: Changes the brain or web search

key: Copied. Nothing was sent — paste it wherever you like.
value: Copié. Rien n’a été envoyé — colle-le où tu veux.
note: 'le' = the report text; privacy line kept literal: nothing was sent.
english: Copied. Nothing was sent — paste it wherever you like.

key: Couldn't open the microphone — tap the face to try again.
value: Impossible d’ouvrir le micro — touche le visage pour réessayer.
english: Couldn't open the microphone — tap the face to try again.

key: Delete all %lld ratings?
note: Ratings = notes (f.). French 'one' covers 0 and 1, so it drops 'toutes' (the dialog only opens with at least one rating). 'many' now matches 'other' (the draft's 'many' had dropped 'toutes').
english: Delete all %lld ratings?

key: Every thumb and note goes. Your conversations stay.
value: Tous les pouces et commentaires sont supprimés. Tes conversations restent.
note: 'note' here is the written comment on a rating, so « commentaire » (ratings are already 'notes'). review set true: it says what is deleted and what stays. « pouces » for thumbs up/down wants a native read.
english: Every thumb and note goes. Your conversations stay.

key: Forget %@? This device stops using its brain; also revoke this device on the Mac.
value: Oublier %@ ? Cet appareil cessera d’utiliser son cerveau ; révoque aussi cet appareil sur le Mac.
note: Future « cessera » reads naturally in a confirmation dialog (the English present describes the consequence). « son cerveau » = the Mac's brain, as ambiguous as the English 'its'.
english: Forget %@? This device stops using its brain; also revoke this device on the Mac.

key: How Apple protects it
value: Comment Apple protège ce que tu envoies
note: Link under Apple's guarantee line ('Apple says Private Cloud Compute uses what you send only to answer it…', PrivateCloudTurn.swift:38). There 'it' means 'what you send', so I named that. 'tes données' was broader than the source and claimed more than Apple's line says.
english: How Apple protects it

key: I hit a snag last time. Send Round Tower a short report? You'll see it first.

key: This is the whole message: that %@ couldn't get ready, what M1K3 showed you, the app and system versions, and M1K3's download log from this session. Nothing you typed or said goes with it. value: Voici l’intégralité du message : le fait que %1$@ n’a pas pu se préparer, ce que M1K3 t’a affiché, les versions de l’app et du système, et le journal de téléchargement de M1K3 pour cette session. Rien de ce que tu as tapé ou dit ne l’accompagne. Il est envoyé à %2$@ depuis ta propre app de messagerie, qui s’ouvre avec le message déjà rempli. M1K3 n’envoie rien lui-même. Round Tower le lit pour trouver ce qui n’a pas marché, et le supprime si tu le demandes.

english: This is the whole message: that %1$@ couldn't get ready, what M1K3 showed you, the app and system versions, and M1K3's download log from this session. Nothing you typed or said goes with it. It goes to %2$@ from your own mail app, which opens with it filled in. M1K3 sends nothing itself. Round Tower reads it to find what went wrong, and deletes it if you ask.

key: This is the whole message: that M1K3 didn't close cleanly last time, when that session began, the brain, the app and system versions, and any crash summaries this device kept. Nothing you typed or said goes with it. It goes to %@ from your own mail app, which opens with it filled in. M1K3 sends nothing itself. Round Tower reads it to find what went wrong, and deletes it if you ask. If you remember what you were doing, add it at the end: that helps most.
value: Voici l’intégralité du message : le fait que M1K3 ne s’est pas fermé correctement la dernière fois, le moment où cette session a commencé, le cerveau, les versions de l’app et du système, et les éventuels résumés de plantage conservés par cet appareil. Rien de ce que tu as tapé ou dit ne l’accompagne. Il est envoyé à %@ depuis ta propre app de messagerie, qui s’ouvre avec le message déjà rempli. M1K3 n’envoie rien lui-même. Round Tower le lit pour trouver ce qui n’a pas marché, et le supprime si tu le demandes. Si tu te souviens de ce que tu faisais, ajoute-le à la fin : c’est ce qui aide le plus.
english: This is the whole message: that M1K3 didn't close cleanly last time, when that session began, the brain, the app and system versions, and any crash summaries this device kept. Nothing you typed or said goes with it. It goes to %@ from your own mail app, which opens with it filled in. M1K3 sends nothing itself. Round Tower reads it to find what went wrong, and deletes it if you ask. If you remember what you were doing, add it at the end: that helps most.

key: NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription
value: Brain at Home se connecte à ton propre Mac via ton Wi-Fi pour que cet appareil puisse utiliser le cerveau plus gros du Mac. Cette connexion reste chiffrée, sur ton propre réseau.
note: Privacy prompt. In the draft, « son cerveau plus gros » could be read as the brain of this device (the visionOS headset), so it now says « du Mac ». The trailing « …réseau, chiffrée » was a calque, so the sentence now reads « reste chiffrée, sur ton propre réseau ». Both facts are kept: the connection stays on the network and it is encrypted. A native reader could choose « plus puissant » instead of « plus gros ».
english: Brain at Home connects to your own Mac over your Wi-Fi so this device can use its bigger brain. That connection stays on your own network, encrypted.

value: M1K3 utilise le microphone pour les conversations vocales. L’audio est transcrit sur ton appareil et ne le quitte jamais.

Both promises keep their strength: 'on-device' and 'never leaves'. « microphone » is kept, as in Apple's system prompts.

value: M1K3 utilise la reconnaissance vocale d’Apple sur l’appareil, donc ta voix reste sur cet appareil. Elle n’est jamais envoyée à un serveur.

Infinitive fragment. It is madeByApp:false, so helloPrivacyLine filters it out today and nothing in the UI renders it yet. Review is true because it says what leaves the device.

key: A warm, natural neural voice that runs entirely on your Mac. One download, then offline forever. The voice M1K3 was meant to have.
value: Une voix neuronale chaleureuse et naturelle qui fonctionne entièrement sur ton Mac. Un seul téléchargement, puis hors ligne pour toujours. La voix que M1K3 devait avoir.
note: Kept. 'entirely' = 'entièrement' and 'offline forever' = 'hors ligne pour toujours', both literal. In 'devait avoir' the imperfect of devoir carries 'was meant to'.
english: A warm, natural neural voice that runs entirely on your Mac. One download, then offline forever. The voice M1K3 was meant to have.

key: A warm, natural neural voice that runs entirely on your device. One download, then offline forever. The voice M1K3 was meant to have.
value: Une voix neuronale chaleureuse et naturelle qui fonctionne entièrement sur ton appareil. Un seul téléchargement, puis hors ligne pour toujours. La voix que M1K3 devait avoir.
note: Kept. The iOS twin of i=0.
english: A warm, natural neural voice that runs entirely on your device. One download, then offline forever. The voice M1K3 was meant to have.

key: Speech recognition isn't allowed — check Settings › Privacy & Security.
value: La reconnaissance vocale n’est pas autorisée — vérifie dans Réglages › Confidentialité et sécurité.
note: Added 'dans' so the line reads like natural French. The string is shared by Mac and iOS. On macOS the app is 'Réglages Système', but the English also says 'Settings' on both, so 'Réglages' stays. A native speaker should decide whether the Mac needs its own key.
english: Speech recognition isn't allowed — check Settings › Privacy & Security.

key: Your device's built-in speech. Works immediately, always on-device — clear, if a little robotic.
value: La synthèse vocale intégrée de ton appareil. Fonctionne immédiatement, toujours sur l’appareil — claire, quoique un peu robotique.
note: Kept. 'always on-device' = 'toujours sur l’appareil', literal.
english: Your device's built-in speech. Works immediately, always on-device — clear, if a little robotic.

key: macOS's built-in speech. Works immediately, always on-device — clear, if a little robotic.
value: La synthèse vocale intégrée de macOS. Fonctionne immédiatement, toujours sur l’appareil — claire, quoique un peu robotique.
note: Kept. 'always on-device' is literal.
english: macOS's built-in speech. Works immediately, always on-device — clear, if a little robotic.

key: NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription
value: Quando você grava uma chamada, o M1K3 capta o áudio do outro lado da linha para transcrever a chamada no seu Mac. O áudio nunca sai do seu Mac.
note: 'the other side's audio' → 'o áudio do outro lado da linha', the usual pt-BR idiom for the other party on a call (bare 'do outro lado' is vague). 'never' kept as 'nunca'.
english: When you record a call, M1K3 captures the other side's audio so it can transcribe the call on your Mac. The audio never leaves your Mac.

key: NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription
value: O M1K3 lê seus próximos eventos (títulos e horários) para fundamentar as respostas — só enquanto o interruptor de contexto do Calendário estiver ligado. Eles ficam neste Mac, com uma exceção: uma busca na web feita pelo M1K3 pode levar palavras deles — a busca na web é um interruptor nos Ajustes.
note: Unchanged. The toggle is labelled 'Calendar (titles & times)' in Ajustes ▸ Privacidade (PrivacySettingsPane.swift:260), so 'Calendário' should match its translated label. 'next few events' → 'seus próximos eventos' drops 'few'; that reads naturally and doesn't weaken the promise, but a native reader can confirm.
english: M1K3 reads your next few events (titles and times) to ground answers — only while the Calendar context toggle is on. They stay on this Mac, except that a web search M1K3 runs can carry words from them — web search is a switch in Settings.

key: NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription
value: O Brain at Home serve o cérebro do M1K3 aos dispositivos que você parear por código QR — só na sua rede local, criptografado, desligado por padrão.
note: 'que você pareia' → 'que você parear' (future subjunctive, the natural form for 'devices you pair'). Brain at Home takes the masculine article, so 'criptografado' and 'desligado por padrão' agree. 'only' → 'só', 'off by default' → 'desligado por padrão', same force.
english: Brain at Home serves M1K3's brain to devices you pair by QR code — on your local network only, encrypted, off by default.

key: NSLocationUsageDescription
value: O M1K3 usa sua localização — uma área aproximada de ~10 km, a menos que você opte pela localização precisa — para fundamentar as respostas, só enquanto o interruptor de contexto da Localização estiver ligado. Ela fica neste Mac, com uma exceção: uma busca na web feita pelo M1K3 pode levá-la — a busca na web é um interruptor nos Ajustes.
note: Unchanged. Must stay identical to item 4. The toggle label is 'Location' (PrivacySettingsPane.swift:271) → 'Localização'.
english: M1K3 uses your location — a coarse ~10 km area unless you opt up to precise — to ground answers, only while the Location context toggle is on. It stays on this Mac, except that a web search M1K3 runs can carry it — web search is a switch in Settings.

key: NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription
value: O M1K3 usa sua localização — uma área aproximada de ~10 km, a menos que você opte pela localização precisa — para fundamentar as respostas, só enquanto o interruptor de contexto da Localização estiver ligado. Ela fica neste Mac, com uma exceção: uma busca na web feita pelo M1K3 pode levá-la — a busca na web é um interruptor nos Ajustes.
note: Unchanged. Identical to item 3.
english: M1K3 uses your location — a coarse ~10 km area unless you opt up to precise — to ground answers, only while the Location context toggle is on. It stays on this Mac, except that a web search M1K3 runs can carry it — web search is a switch in Settings.

key: NSMicrophoneUsageDescription
value: O M1K3 usa o microfone para a entrada de voz. O áudio é transcrito no dispositivo e nunca sai do seu Mac.
english: M1K3 uses the microphone for voice input. Audio is transcribed on-device and never leaves your Mac.

key: NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription
value: O M1K3 usa o reconhecimento de voz da Apple no dispositivo, então sua voz fica neste Mac. Ela nunca é enviada a um servidor.
note: Unchanged. Uses the lower-case feature wording 'reconhecimento de voz', as the store copy does, because this line describes Apple's on-device engine. It does not name the system permission ('Reconhecimento de Fala').
english: M1K3 uses Apple's on-device speech recognition, so your voice stays on this Mac. It is never sent to a server.

key: %@ is thinking · private by design
value: %@ está pensando · privado por design
english: %@ is thinking · private by design

key: A line about you seeds my memory — "I teach primary school", "short answers, please". It stays on this Mac, and you can edit it any time in Settings → You.
value: Uma linha sobre você é a semente da minha memória — “Dou aula no ensino fundamental”, “respostas curtas, por favor”. Ela fica neste Mac, e você pode editá-la quando quiser em Ajustes → Você.
note: Privacy line (“stays on this Mac”), translated literally. “Ajustes → Você” must match the translation of the “You” settings tab (SettingsView.swift:68).
english: A line about you seeds my memory — "I teach primary school", "short answers, please". It stays on this Mac, and you can edit it any time in Settings → You.

key: A serif face; some readers find the strokes easier to track.
value: Uma fonte serifada; alguns leitores acham os traços mais fáceis de acompanhar.
english: A serif face; some readers find the strokes easier to track.

key: A testing aid: shows context tokens and tokens/sec under each answer from Lil or Big. Mini (Apple's on-device model) doesn't report generation metrics.
value: Um recurso de teste: mostra os tokens de contexto e os tokens/s abaixo de cada resposta do Lil ou do Big. O Mini (o modelo no dispositivo da Apple) não informa métricas de geração.
english: A testing aid: shows context tokens and tokens/sec under each answer from Lil or Big. Mini (Apple's on-device model) doesn't report generation metrics.

english: Add one above. M1K3 and connected agents can suggest todos; suggestions wait here for your say-so.

english: Agent Log — MCP tool calls captured from connected agents (opt-in)

english: Also send this conversation

note: The batch had review:false. Set to true because the line says which other devices get M1K3's tools (Brain at Home egress).
english: Also serve MCP tools to paired devices

key: Apple Intelligence isn't available here, so I'll fetch my own brain — %@ M1K3, a one-time %@ download. Still fully on this Mac.
value: A Apple Intelligence não está disponível aqui, então vou baixar meu próprio cérebro — %1$@ M1K3, um download único de %2$@. Continua totalmente neste Mac.
note: %1$@ is the tier name (for example 'Lil'), %2$@ the download size. 'Still fully on this Mac' keeps its exact force as 'Continua totalmente neste Mac', with no 'only' added.
english: Apple Intelligence isn't available here, so I'll fetch my own brain — %1$@ M1K3, a one-time %2$@ download. Still fully on this Mac.

key: Apple Intelligence isn’t available on this Mac. M1K3’s own Mini runs here after a one-time download.
value: A Apple Intelligence não está disponível neste Mac. O Mini do próprio M1K3 roda aqui depois de um download único.
english: Apple Intelligence isn’t available on this Mac. M1K3’s own Mini runs here after a one-time download.

key: Ask M1K3 a question and get a grounded answer from your local knowledge.
value: Faça uma pergunta ao M1K3 e receba uma resposta fundamentada no seu conhecimento local.
english: Ask M1K3 a question and get a grounded answer from your local knowledge.

key: Built-in is Apple's default voice. M1K3 Voice downloads a neural voice model and runs entirely offline. Character shapes the tone — Clean is the full range, M1K3 is the signature sound, Radio leans lo-fi. Hit “Hear a sample” to compare.
value: Integrada é a voz padrão da Apple. A Voz do M1K3 baixa um modelo de voz neural e funciona totalmente offline. O Estilo define o tom — Clean é a gama completa, M1K3 é o som característico, Radio puxa para o lo-fi. Clique em “Ouvir uma amostra” para comparar.
note: Two cross-catalog dependencies. (1) Sources/M1K3Voice's catalog marks “M1K3 Voice” shouldTranslate:false, so the voice picker shows “M1K3 Voice” in English while this paragraph says “Voz do M1K3” (as the term table says). A human should pick one. (2) “Clean” and “Radio” are translatable voice character names in M1K3Voice (no pt-BR value yet). Kept in English here, so that catalog must keep them in English too or this line must change to match.
english: Built-in is Apple's default voice. M1K3 Voice downloads a neural voice model and runs entirely offline. Character shapes the tone — Clean is the full range, M1K3 is the signature sound, Radio leans lo-fi. Hit “Hear a sample” to compare.

key: Calendar (titles & times)
value: Calendário (títulos e horários)
note: Per-sense consent toggle in Privacy ▸ Context. It says what M1K3 may read, so it is translated literally. “Calendário” is Apple's app name.
english: Calendar (titles & times)

english: Couldn’t save a new key to the Keychain. The current one still works.

value: Os downloads vêm de huggingface.co (e de github.com para o pacote de voz), uma única vez, e depois rodam neste Mac. Nada é removido sem perguntar.
english: Downloads come from huggingface.co (and github.com for the voice pack), once, and then run on this Mac. Nothing is removed without asking.

key: Dress M1K3 up for the occasional holiday — Halloween, and flight colours while you are offline.
value: Fantasie o M1K3 numa data especial de vez em quando — Halloween, e um visual de voo enquanto você está offline.
note: 'flight colours' is the Offline AI Flight Club look (NetworkPathWatch.swift). 'cores de voo' was a calque, so it became 'um visual de voo', matching 'Visuais sazonais'. 'Vista … para um feriado' became 'Fantasie … numa data especial' (Halloween isn't a feriado in Brazil).
english: Dress M1K3 up for the occasional holiday — Halloween, and flight colours while you are offline.

key: Drop a PDF or text file on the window, or activate to pick one. Files are read on this Mac only.
value: Solte um PDF ou arquivo de texto na janela, ou ative para escolher um. Os arquivos são lidos só neste Mac.
english: Drop a PDF or text file on the window, or activate to pick one. Files are read on this Mac only.

key: Drop or import a PDF or text file and it'll appear here. Photos you ask me to remember appear too; their descriptions stay on this device.
value: Solte ou importe um PDF ou arquivo de texto e ele aparece aqui. As fotos que você me pede para lembrar também aparecem; as descrições delas ficam neste dispositivo.
english: Drop or import a PDF or text file and it'll appear here. Photos you ask me to remember appear too; their descriptions stay on this device.

key: Email this one exchange to Round Tower — you see the exact text first
value: Enviar por e-mail só esta troca de mensagens para a Round Tower — você vê o texto exato antes
note: Marked review because it describes what leaves the device. A bare 'troca' reads as 'swap', so it became 'troca de mensagens'. The sibling keys 'Send this exchange…' and 'Send this exchange to Round Tower?' (another batch) should use the same wording.
english: Email this one exchange to Round Tower — you see the exact text first

key: Every agent you’ve connected stops reaching M1K3 until you connect it again with the new token.
value: Todo agente que você conectou deixa de acessar o M1K3 até você conectá-lo outra vez com o novo token.
english: Every agent you’ve connected stops reaching M1K3 until you connect it again with the new token.

key: Every app you’ve pointed at M1K3 stops working until you give it the new key.
value: Todo app que você apontou para o M1K3 para de funcionar até você dar a ele a nova chave.
english: Every app you’ve pointed at M1K3 stops working until you give it the new key.

key: Every couple of hours M1K3 can take stock — what it learned, who called in, how the machine is doing — and write a short note. Turn it on in Settings → M1K3. Kept on this machine only.
value: A cada duas horas, mais ou menos, o M1K3 pode fazer um balanço — o que aprendeu, quem se conectou, como está a máquina — e escrever uma nota curta. Ligue isso nos Ajustes → M1K3. Guardada só nesta máquina.
note: 'who called in' means the agents that reached M1K3 (HeartbeatScreen.swift:194: 'who called in, and what they used'), not phone calls, so it became 'quem se conectou' instead of 'quem ligou'. 'Ligue nos Ajustes' could also be read as 'make a call', so it became 'Ligue isso'. 'Guardada' agrees with 'nota'.
english: Every couple of hours M1K3 can take stock — what it learned, who called in, how the machine is doing — and write a short note. Turn it on in Settings → M1K3. Kept on this machine only.

key: Every couple of hours M1K3 takes stock and writes a short note. Kept on this machine, capped at a week, never remembered as facts.
value: A cada duas horas, mais ou menos, o M1K3 faz um balanço e escreve uma nota curta. Fica nesta máquina, por no máximo uma semana, e nunca é guardada na memória como fato.
english: Every couple of hours M1K3 takes stock and writes a short note. Kept on this machine, capped at a week, never remembered as facts.

key: Exports every remembered fact as plain-text Markdown. Outside M1K3 this folder is not encrypted — it's yours to guard.
value: Exporta cada fato guardado na memória como Markdown em texto simples. Fora do M1K3, esta pasta não é criptografada — cabe a você protegê-la.
english: Exports every remembered fact as plain-text Markdown. Outside M1K3 this folder is not encrypted — it's yours to guard.

key: Forget this — removes it everywhere, no residue
value: Esquecer isto — remove de todos os lugares, sem deixar rastro
note: The draft dropped 'this' and used 'apaga' for 'removes'. The term table keeps Remove → Remover apart from Delete → Apagar, and privacy copy is translated literally.
english: Forget this — removes it everywhere, no residue

english: Full transcript in the Agent Log

english: How Apple protects it

key: How you asked M1K3 to answer. The newest asks shape every answer on this Mac, as many as fit.
value: Como você pediu que o M1K3 respondesse. Os pedidos mais recentes, quantos couberem, moldam todas as respostas neste Mac.
note: Moved 'quantos couberem' next to its noun. At the end of the sentence it dangled and read as if it referred to the answers.
english: How you asked M1K3 to answer. The newest asks shape every answer on this Mac, as many as fit.

value: Tive um problema da última vez. Enviar um relatório curto para a Round Tower? Você vai vê-lo antes.

value: Eu lembro das coisas — de verdade, neste Mac.
english: I remember things — properly, on this Mac.

value: Incluir resumos de falhas/travamentos gerados no dispositivo
english: Include on-device crash/hang summaries

value: Manter neste Mac
english: Keep it on this Mac

value: Permitir que agentes apaguem lembranças
english: Let agents delete memories

value: Permitir que agentes abram links na tela
note: Review flipped to true: it is a permission toggle that grants agents a capability, the same as its siblings i=2 and i=4.
english: Let agents open links on screen

key: Let agents use the microphone
value: Permitir que agentes usem o microfone
english: Let agents use the microphone

key: Lets M1K3 ground answers in the moment — battery, your next events, where you are (a coarse ~10 km area unless Precise is on). Snapshots only: never remembered, never mixed with web tools in a turn. macOS asks its own permission when you switch Calendar or Location on.
value: Permite que o M1K3 fundamente as respostas no momento presente — bateria, seus próximos eventos, onde você está (uma área aproximada de ~10 km, a menos que a Localização Precisa esteja ligada). Só instantâneos: nunca guardados na memória, nunca misturados com ferramentas da web na mesma rodada. O macOS faz o próprio pedido de permissão quando você liga Calendário ou Localização.
note: 'in the moment' was 'no momento', which reads as 'at the moment'; now 'no momento presente'. 'Precise' is the 'Precise location' toggle (Localização Precisa), now with its article. 'Calendário' / 'Localização' must match the translated toggle labels.
english: Lets M1K3 ground answers in the moment — battery, your next events, where you are (a coarse ~10 km area unless Precise is on). Snapshots only: never remembered, never mixed with web tools in a turn. macOS asks its own permission when you switch Calendar or Location on.

key: Lets an agent on this Mac use M1K3's knowledge, memory and voice. Loopback-only, one client at a time. An agent needs the access token to connect. Listening, deleting memories and opening links stay off until you allow them.
value: Permite que um agente neste Mac use o conhecimento, a memória e a voz do M1K3. Só via loopback, um cliente por vez. Um agente precisa do token de acesso para se conectar. Ouvir, apagar lembranças e abrir links ficam desligados até você permitir.
note: 'Loopback-only' changed from the bare 'Só loopback' to 'Só via loopback'.
english: Lets an agent on this Mac use M1K3's knowledge, memory and voice. Loopback-only, one client at a time. An agent needs the access token to connect. Listening, deleting memories and opening links stay off until you allow them.

key: Lets other apps on this Mac use the brain M1K3 has loaded, with their own instructions: no M1K3 personality, memory, knowledge or tools, and nothing they send is kept. Point any OpenAI-compatible tool at the base URL and use the API key. Loopback-only, one call at a time, and you always go first. M1K3's brains are chosen and tested inside M1K3; how one behaves under another app's instructions is for you to judge.
value: Permite que outros apps neste Mac usem o cérebro que o M1K3 carregou, com as instruções deles: sem a personalidade, a memória, o conhecimento nem as ferramentas do M1K3, e nada do que eles enviam é guardado. Aponte qualquer ferramenta compatível com OpenAI para a URL base e use a chave de API. Só via loopback, uma chamada por vez, e você sempre tem prioridade. Os cérebros do M1K3 são escolhidos e testados dentro do M1K3; como um deles se comporta sob as instruções de outro app cabe a você julgar.
note: 'you always go first' changed from the literal 'você sempre vem primeiro' to 'você sempre tem prioridade' (your own turns take priority over Local API calls).
english: Lets other apps on this Mac use the brain M1K3 has loaded, with their own instructions: no M1K3 personality, memory, knowledge or tools, and nothing they send is kept. Point any OpenAI-compatible tool at the base URL and use the API key. Loopback-only, one call at a time, and you always go first. M1K3's brains are chosen and tested inside M1K3; how one behaves under another app's instructions is for you to judge.

key: Local API
value: Local API
english: Local API

value: Local API (compatível com OpenAI, localhost)

key: Looking at what's already on this Mac…
value: Verificando o que já há neste Mac…

english: M1K3 doesn't capture agent conversations by default. Turn on “Log agent conversations” in Settings → Server to review what a connected agent asks for and hears back — on this Mac only.

key: M1K3 extracts durable facts about you — preferences, decisions, people — from conversations, on-device. Review and erase anytime.
value: O M1K3 extrai fatos duradouros sobre você — preferências, decisões, pessoas — das conversas, no dispositivo. Revise e apague quando quiser.
english: M1K3 extracts durable facts about you — preferences, decisions, people — from conversations, on-device. Review and erase anytime.

key: M1K3 is built with open-source components. Everything runs on this Mac.
value: O M1K3 é feito com componentes de código aberto. Tudo roda neste Mac.
english: M1K3 is built with open-source components. Everything runs on this Mac.

key: M1K3 keeps your words on this Mac — ask it anything.
value: O M1K3 guarda suas palavras neste Mac — pergunte o que quiser.
english: M1K3 keeps your words on this Mac — ask it anything.

key: M1K3 won't open a page on this Mac or a private network.

key: M1K3's "hands" — it can only propose a script; every install and approval is your click, and only the exact approved bytes ever run. Script output can't reach the web tools in the same turn and never becomes a remembered fact. An approved script can be re-run later with different input, so approve only scripts you trust with anything.
value: As “mãos” do M1K3 — ele só pode propor um script; cada instalação e aprovação é um clique seu, e só os bytes exatos aprovados chegam a rodar. A saída de um script não alcança as ferramentas da web na mesma rodada e nunca vira um fato guardado na memória. Um script aprovado pode rodar de novo depois com outra entrada, então aprove só scripts aos quais você confiaria qualquer coisa.
note: The batch flag is false, but this line says what script output can and cannot reach (web tools, memory), so it stays held for review. 'only' and 'never' keep their full force.
english: M1K3's "hands" — it can only propose a script; every install and approval is your click, and only the exact approved bytes ever run. Script output can't reach the web tools in the same turn and never becomes a remembered fact. An approved script can be re-run later with different input, so approve only scripts you trust with anything.

english: Off unless you turn it on. Then Private Cloud Compute joins the brain picker, and once you pick it, it stays picked until you choose a brain on this Mac. The first time, you see exactly what goes before it goes, and each answer is labelled.

english: Serves raw generation to devices you pair by QR code — local network only, encrypted with a key that never travels the network; no persona, memory, or documents included. The MCP toggle adds read-only tools (search, documents, ask) — asks can reach the web when the web-search toggle allows. Off by default; revoking a device cuts it off immediately.

key: This is the whole message: that M1K3 didn't close cleanly last time, when that session began, the brain, the app and macOS versions, and any crash summaries this Mac kept. Nothing you typed or said goes with it. It goes to %@ from your own mail app, which opens with it filled in. M1K3 sends nothing itself. Round Tower reads it to find what went wrong, and deletes it if you ask. If you remember what you were doing, add it at the end: that helps most.
value: Esta é a mensagem inteira: que o M1K3 não fechou corretamente da última vez, quando essa sessão começou, o cérebro, as versões do app e do macOS, e quaisquer resumos de falhas que este Mac tenha guardado. Nada do que você digitou ou disse vai junto. Ela vai para %@ pelo seu próprio app de e-mail, que abre com a mensagem já preenchida. O M1K3 não envia nada sozinho. A Round Tower a lê para descobrir o que deu errado e a apaga se você pedir. Se você lembrar o que estava fazendo, adicione no final: isso é o que mais ajuda.
note: Made 'any crash summaries' plural (quaisquer resumos) and replaced the awkward 'abre com ela já preenchida'.
english: This is the whole message: that M1K3 didn't close cleanly last time, when that session began, the brain, the app and macOS versions, and any crash summaries this Mac kept. Nothing you typed or said goes with it. It goes to %@ from your own mail app, which opens with it filled in. M1K3 sends nothing itself. Round Tower reads it to find what went wrong, and deletes it if you ask. If you remember what you were doing, add it at the end: that helps most.

key: This is the whole message: your message, M1K3's answer, your note, the brain and the app version — nothing else from this Mac, though the answer may quote what M1K3 read to write it. It goes to %@ from your own mail app, which opens with it filled in. M1K3 sends nothing itself. Round Tower reads it to fix what went wrong, may rewrite it as a made-up test case, and deletes it if you ask. Change anything below first if you like.
value: Esta é a mensagem inteira: sua mensagem, a resposta do M1K3, seu comentário, o cérebro e a versão do app — nada mais deste Mac, embora a resposta possa citar o que o M1K3 leu para escrevê-la. Ela vai para %@ pelo seu próprio app de e-mail, que abre com a mensagem já preenchida. O M1K3 não envia nada sozinho. A Round Tower a lê para corrigir o que deu errado, pode reescrevê-la como um caso de teste inventado e a apaga se você pedir. Se quiser, altere qualquer coisa abaixo antes.
note: 'your note' is the feedback note, so 'seu comentário' per the term table. Last sentence reworded: the draft's 'altere o que preferir abaixo antes' was clunky.
english: This is the whole message: your message, M1K3's answer, your note, the brain and the app version — nothing else from this Mac, though the answer may quote what M1K3 read to write it. It goes to %@ from your own mail app, which opens with it filled in. M1K3 sends nothing itself. Round Tower reads it to fix what went wrong, may rewrite it as a made-up test case, and deletes it if you ask. Change anything below first if you like.

key: This page tried to send the panel to a file on this Mac or a private-network address. M1K3 won’t open those on a page’s say-so.

note: 'those' covers both files and addresses, so 'esses destinos' instead of 'esses endereços'; 'redirecionar' reads more naturally than 'levar'.
english: This page tried to send the panel to a file on this Mac or a private-network address. M1K3 won’t open those on a page’s say-so.

note: Kept 'Declared Age Range' as Apple's API/feature name. A native reviewer should confirm whether Apple pt-BR localises it. No call sites: may be a stale key.
english: Uses Apple's Declared Age Range to adjust content for younger users. Web search is disabled for users under 16; the assistant's tone adjusts for all minors. Declining gives full capability.

english: What M1K3 knows about you — it rides every conversation's system prompt. Stored on this machine only, never retrieved or cited, yours to edit or clear.

'Capturado'/'desligado' agree with Registro; 'as 500 mais recentes' agrees with chamadas.

english: Your next message is answered from this text again, on this Mac

key: NSCameraUsageDescription
value: O M1K3 usa a câmera para escanear o código de pareamento do Brain at Home que aparece no seu Mac e para olhar o que você aponta com ela quando você pede. O M1K3 lê o que vê neste dispositivo e não envia isso para lugar nenhum. Uma imagem sobre a qual você pergunta fica salva com essa conversa neste dispositivo.
note: Reviewer changes: 'que seu Mac mostra para o Brain at Home' could be read as the Mac showing the code TO Brain at Home, so it now reads 'o código de pareamento do Brain at Home que aparece no seu Mac'. 'o que você aponta para ela' (pointing toward the camera) became 'o que você aponta com ela'. 'quadro' can read as a painting to a lay user, so 'frame' is now 'imagem' (one still from the camera, not a stronger or weaker promise). 'aquela conversa' became 'essa conversa', which is more natural. Privacy force unchanged: read on this device, sent nowhere, saved only with that chat on this device.
english: M1K3 uses the camera to scan the pairing code your Mac shows for Brain at Home, and to look at what you point it at when you ask. M1K3 reads what it sees on this device and sends it nowhere. A frame you ask about is saved with that chat on this device.

key: NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription
value: O Brain at Home se conecta ao seu próprio Mac pela sua rede Wi-Fi para que este dispositivo possa usar o cérebro maior dele. Essa conexão fica na sua própria rede, criptografada.

key: Sends it as your next message
value: Envia como sua próxima mensagem
note: VoiceOver hint on a choice button (AnswerBlockText.swift:66): the option's visible words are sent as the person's next message. Review kept true as the batch flags it; the meaning is exact, nothing added about where it goes.
english: Sends it as your next message

key: Offline? I'm still right here, on your device.
value: Offline? Continuo bem aqui, no seu dispositivo.
note: 'bem aqui' now carries 'right here' (the draft had lost 'right'), and the subject pronoun is dropped so it reads naturally. The line is 47 characters, under the 70 limit. It promises that M1K3 is there, never that it will answer, as the comment requires. Flagged for review because it says where M1K3 runs.
english: Offline? I'm still right here, on your device.

key: Microphone access is off. Enable it in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone.
value: O acesso ao microfone está desligado. Ative-o nos Ajustes do Sistema → Privacidade e Segurança → Microfone.
note: Permission line. 'em Ajustes do Sistema' became 'nos Ajustes do Sistema', because Ajustes takes the masculine plural article (the glossary has 'Aprovar nos Ajustes do Sistema…'). Kept 'Ative-o' (Apple's usual pt-BR verb for a permission toggle) over 'Ligue-o'. The path names are Apple's pt-BR names and the → separators are kept.
english: Microphone access is off. Enable it in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone.

key: The microphone isn’t ready yet — try again in a moment.
value: O microfone ainda não está pronto — tente de novo em um instante.
note: The batch flags this one review:true, so it stays true, though it reads as a readiness message rather than a permission or egress line.
english: The microphone isn’t ready yet — try again in a moment.

key: %@ answers. Web search is off.
value: %@ responde. A busca na web está desligada.
note: No article before %@, so the line works for tier names and for Private Cloud Compute. An article before a proper name is optional in pt-BR.
english: %@ answers. Web search is off.

key: %@ answers. Web search is on.
value: %@ responde. A busca na web está ligada.
note: No article before %@, so the line works for tier names and for Private Cloud Compute.
english: %@ answers. Web search is on.

key: %@ can't remember photos. Switch to Lil to remember photos.
value: O %@ não consegue guardar fotos na memória. Troque para o Lil para guardar fotos na memória.
note: %@ can only be Mini or Pocket (ImageCaptionPolicy.swift:46), so the masculine 'O' is always right.
english: %@ can't remember photos. Switch to Lil to remember photos.

key: This brain can't read photos right now.
value: Este cérebro não consegue ler fotos agora.
english: This brain can't read photos right now.

key: %@ are each a switch in Settings.
value: %@ têm, cada um, um interruptor nos Ajustes.
note: The argument comes from NetworkCrossings.joined() (NetworkCrossings.swift:178-185), which joins the names with a hard-coded English "and" / ", and ", so pt-BR shows "Busca na web and Private Cloud Compute têm…". joined() needs a ListFormatter or a localised "e". This is part of the first-run privacy line, so it is held for review.
english: %@ are each a switch in Settings.

key: %@ is a switch in Settings.
value: %@ tem um interruptor nos Ajustes.
note: The argument is the switch label ("Busca na web" or "Private Cloud Compute"), read as a name, so it has no article. This sentence is the %2$@ tail of the first-run privacy line and is held for review with it.
english: %@ is a switch in Settings.

key: A fully local engine — multi-turn conversation, memory, and reasoning that keeps up with you. Runs entirely on your Vision Pro.
value: Um motor totalmente local — conversas com várias trocas, memória e raciocínio que acompanha seu ritmo. Roda inteiramente no seu Vision Pro.
english: A fully local engine — multi-turn conversation, memory, and reasoning that keeps up with you. Runs entirely on your Vision Pro.

key: A fully local engine — multi-turn conversation, memory, and reasoning that keeps up with you. Runs entirely on your device.
value: Um motor totalmente local — conversas com várias trocas, memória e raciocínio que acompanha seu ritmo. Roda inteiramente no seu dispositivo.
english: A fully local engine — multi-turn conversation, memory, and reasoning that keeps up with you. Runs entirely on your device.

key: A fully local engine — multi-turn conversation, memory, and reasoning that keeps up with you. Runs entirely on your machine.
value: Um motor totalmente local — conversas com várias trocas, memória e raciocínio que acompanha seu ritmo. Roda inteiramente na sua máquina.
english: A fully local engine — multi-turn conversation, memory, and reasoning that keeps up with you. Runs entirely on your machine.

key: Apple's built-in on-device model. No download. The quickest way to start.
value: O modelo integrado da Apple, no dispositivo. Sem download. O jeito mais rápido de começar.
english: Apple's built-in on-device model. No download. The quickest way to start.

key: Besides model downloads, the one capability that sends anything off this Mac: every search and page read shows in the reply as it happens. Date, time, and system tools stay local either way.
value: Além dos downloads de modelos, é o único recurso que envia algo para fora deste Mac: cada busca e cada leitura de página aparece na resposta no momento em que acontece. Data, hora e ferramentas do sistema continuam locais de qualquer forma.
english: Besides model downloads, the one capability that sends anything off this Mac: every search and page read shows in the reply as it happens. Date, time, and system tools stay local either way.

key: Every search and page read shows in the reply as it happens. Date, time, and system tools stay local either way.
value: Cada busca e cada leitura de página aparece na resposta no momento em que acontece. Data, hora e ferramentas do sistema continuam locais de qualquer forma.
note: Marked for review because it says what stays local, even though the batch item says review:false.
english: Every search and page read shows in the reply as it happens. Date, time, and system tools stay local either way.

key: Maximum capability, fully local. The full M1K3.
value: Capacidade máxima, totalmente local. O M1K3 completo.
english: Maximum capability, fully local. The full M1K3.

key: My everyday brain. Quick, sees pictures, lives on this Mac.
value: Meu cérebro do dia a dia. Rápido, enxerga imagens, mora neste Mac.
english: My everyday brain. Quick, sees pictures, lives on this Mac.

key: Your local AI companion. Runs on this Mac — no account. It goes online only to %@. %@
value: Seu companheiro de IA local. Roda neste Mac — sem conta. Ele só se conecta à internet para %1$@. %2$@
note: %1$@ is a list of infinitive phrases ("baixar os modelos…"), so "para" + infinitive reads correctly. "only" is kept as "só". The list is joined with a hard-coded English "and" (NetworkCrossings.joined()), which needs a localised conjunction. %2$@ is the Settings-switch sentence.
english: Your local AI companion. Runs on this Mac — no account. It goes online only to %1$@. %2$@

key: download the models you choose (brains, speech, voice)
value: baixar os modelos que você escolher (cérebros, fala, voz)
note: Infinitive fragment joined after "para" in the host line "It goes online only to %@". Kept as drafted. Set to review: true (the batch had false) because it says what leaves the device.
english: download the models you choose (brains, speech, voice)

key: email one exchange, or a short report after a snag or a failed brain download, to Round Tower when you choose to
value: enviar por e-mail uma troca de mensagens, ou um relatório curto depois de um problema ou de uma falha no download de um cérebro, para a Round Tower quando você optar por isso
note: Changed "quando você escolher" (bare transitive verb with no object) to "quando você optar por isso". It keeps the exact opt-in force of "when you choose to". Set to review: true (the batch had false) because it says what leaves the device. This crossing has madeByApp false, so the hello line does not show it today, but the phrase still has to read after "para".
english: email one exchange, or a short report after a snag or a failed brain download, to Round Tower when you choose to

key: search the web and look things up
value: buscar na web e consultar informações
note: Kept as drafted. Infinitive fragment after "para". Uses "buscar" as the glossary requires, never "pesquisar".
english: search the web and look things up

key: use the optional Private Cloud Compute brain
value: usar o cérebro opcional do Private Cloud Compute
note: Kept as drafted. Private Cloud Compute stays English, and "optional" is kept literally (opt-in force unchanged).
english: use the optional Private Cloud Compute brain

key: A warm, natural neural voice that runs entirely on your Mac. One download, then offline forever. The voice M1K3 was meant to have.
value: Uma voz neural calorosa e natural que roda inteiramente no seu Mac. Um download, depois offline para sempre. A voz que o M1K3 nasceu para ter.
note: Says what stays on the device ('entirely on your Mac', 'offline forever'). Translated literally with the same force.
english: A warm, natural neural voice that runs entirely on your Mac. One download, then offline forever. The voice M1K3 was meant to have.

note: Says what stays on the device. Translated literally with the same force.
english: A warm, natural neural voice that runs entirely on your device. One download, then offline forever. The voice M1K3 was meant to have.

key: Speech recognition isn't allowed — check Settings › Privacy & Security.
value: O Reconhecimento de Fala não foi permitido — confira Ajustes › Privacidade e Segurança.
note: Permission line, shared by Mac and iOS. 'Ajustes' is the iOS Settings app name and the short form of the Mac's 'Ajustes do Sistema'. 'Privacidade e Segurança' and 'Reconhecimento de Fala' are Apple's pt-BR names. The › separator is kept.
english: Speech recognition isn't allowed — check Settings › Privacy & Security.

key: Your device's built-in speech. Works immediately, always on-device — clear, if a little robotic.
value: A voz integrada do seu dispositivo. Funciona na hora, sempre no dispositivo — clara, embora um pouco robótica.
note: Changed: 'fala integrada' is now 'voz integrada'. It matches the tier name 'Integrada' and the term table ('a voz integrada'), and gives 'clara' and 'robótica' a noun to agree with. 'always on-device' is privacy copy, kept literal as 'sempre no dispositivo'.
english: Your device's built-in speech. Works immediately, always on-device — clear, if a little robotic.

key: macOS's built-in speech. Works immediately, always on-device — clear, if a little robotic.
value: A voz integrada do macOS. Funciona na hora, sempre no dispositivo — clara, embora um pouco robótica.
note: Changed: 'fala integrada' is now 'voz integrada', for the same reason as item 12. 'always on-device' is kept literal as 'sempre no dispositivo'.
